title: Marketplace Manager (Amazon & Bol.com, Kaufland E-bay etc.))
description:
Hi there,

We’re a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling premium consumer products across multiple online marketplaces, including Amazon and 
. Our mission is simple: build category-leading brands by combining outstanding products with operational excellence, data-driven decision making, and exceptional customer experience.



As we continue to scale internationally, we're looking for a **Marketplace Manager** who takes ownership, thinks commercially, and is passionate about growing online sales.



---



The Role:



We're hiring a **Marketplace Manager** to manage and grow our marketplace presence across Amazon, 
, and future European marketplaces.

---



What You'll Do:



- Manage our Amazon Seller Central and 
 seller accounts

- Optimize and improve product listings (titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, A+ Content, keywords)

- Launch new products and expand into new marketplaces

- Monitor listing health and resolve suppressions or compliance issues

- Manage inventory levels and coordinate with suppliers to prevent stock-outs

- Analyze sales, profitability, conversion rates, traffic, and marketplace KPIs

- Plan and execute PPC campaigns (Amazon Ads & 
 Advertising)

- Continuously optimize advertising performance and ACOS/ROAS

- Monitor competitors, pricing, and market trends

- Identify opportunities to increase organic rankings and conversions

- Handle account health and performance metrics

- Resolve marketplace policy issues, warnings, and account notifications

- Communicate with marketplace support when necessary

- Improve customer experience by reducing returns and customer service issues

- Work closely with designers, copywriters, and marketing to improve product pages

- Create weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights

- Develop strategies to increase revenue and profitability across all marketplaces

- Identify automation opportunities and improve internal processes



---



You Need:



- Proven experience managing Amazon Seller Central and/or 
 accounts

- Strong understanding of marketplace SEO and product listing optimization

- Experience with Amazon PPC (experience with 
 advertising is a plus)

- Excellent analytical skills and confidence working with spreadsheets and data

- Strong understanding of e-commerce KPIs (CTR, CVR, TACoS, ACOS, ROAS, etc.)

- Ability to solve problems independently and take ownership

- Strong English communication skills (Dutch is a plus)

- Highly organized with excellent attention to detail

- Commercial mindset focused on scaling revenue and profitability

- Experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) is a plus



---



What You'll Get:



- **Starting salary: $5 per hour (40 hours per week)**

- Salary increases based on performance and results

- Performance bonuses

- Fully remote position

- Long-term career opportunity within a rapidly growing e-commerce company

- Direct collaboration with the Founder and management team

- Significant ownership and freedom to make an impact

- Opportunity to build and scale multiple international brands



---

title: SOLAR CAD DESIGNER – CALIFORNIA
description:
Job Type: Project-Based / Freelance

Location: Remote

Project Volume: As needed

Turnaround: 24 hours per project



We are looking for an experienced Solar CAD Designer who specializes in California solar projects to join our team on a project-based basis.



We need someone who can take project information and produce accurate, permit-ready solar plans within 24 hours. You should be very familiar with California permitting requirements, utility standards, and AHJ-specific requirements.



What You'll Do



-Create professional, accurate, and permit-ready solar PV plans



-Prepare Single-Line Diagrams (SLDs), site plans, electrical plans, and equipment layouts



-Design residential and/or commercial solar systems based on project requirements



-Incorporate battery storage, ESS, EV chargers, MPU/service upgrades, and other electrical equipment when applicable



-Review existing plans and make revisions based on AHJ/utility comments



-Ensure plans comply with applicable California codes, utility requirements, and local AHJ requirements



-Make revisions quickly and accurately when corrections are requested



-Coordinate with our Project Managers when clarification is needed



-Maintain a consistent turnaround time of 24 hours per project



Requirements



-Proven experience as a Solar CAD Designer / PV Designer

-Strong experience designing California solar projects

-Excellent knowledge of California permitting and electrical requirements

-Familiarity with different California AHJs and utility requirements, including SCE, PG&E, SDG&E, IID, LADWP, etc.

-Experience with PV + battery storage / ESS designs

-Ability to produce accurate SLDs and detailed permit plan sets

-Proficiency in relevant CAD/design software such as AutoCAD, Aurora Solar, PVcase, HelioScope, or similar

-Strong attention to detail

-Able to work independently with minimal supervision

-Able to consistently complete projects within a 24-hour turnaround

-Good communication and responsiveness



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who can hit the ground running. You should already understand how California solar permitting works and should not need extensive training on basic PV design requirements.



You should be someone who:



*Takes ownership of assigned projects

*Can identify potential design/permitting issues before submitting plans

*Doesn't wait to be told every step of the process

*Can work efficiently under tight deadlines

*Produces quality work even with a fast turnaround

*Is responsive when revisions or urgent projects come up



HOW TO APPLY



Please send us:



*Your resume/CV



*Examples of California solar plans you've designed (portfolio/sample plans)



*The CAD/design software you are proficient in



*Your experience with California AHJs and utilities



*Your rate per project or preferred pricing structure



*Your typical turnaround time for a standard residential solar project



Important: Please only apply if you are confident that you can consistently deliver accurate, permit-ready plans within 24 hours.

description:
*KINDLY READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION & THE APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY.*



EJF is a property management company headquartered in Washington, DC. We are looking for Assistant Property Managers for our growing team. A successful candidate will enjoy solving problems, is responsible, organized, detail oriented, and reliable.



Role Purpose:



The Associate Community Manager (ACM) is responsible for supporting the Community Association Manager (CAM) in the daily operations, financial oversight, administrative functions, and resident/board communications of assigned associations. The ACM ensures timely execution of operational tasks, accurate financial processing, regulatory compliance, and consistent communication, allowing the CAM to focus on strategic management and board leadership.



 Core Responsibilities:

Respond to resident, vendor, and internal inquiries within 2 business hours.

Respond to board member requests, concerns, and follow-ups in a timely and professional manner.

Prepare and distribute broadcast
s, notices, and announcements to residents.

Address and escalate property-related issues as appropriate.

Participate in and contribute to daily huddles.

Prepare and send weekly updates.

 

2. Financial & Accounting Support:



Review and approve invoices.

Ensure monthly utility bills are processed and paid on time.

Review invoice GL coding, descriptions, and amounts for accuracy.

Run General Ledger (GL) reports.

Review monthly financial statements and reclassify mis-coded transactions.

Bill back homeowners for chargeable items.

Submit add-charge requests as required.

Assist the CAM with preparation of annual association budgets.

 

3. Vendor, Contract & Procurement Support:



Gather and organize existing contracts.

Request bids and proposals from vendors in coordination with the CAM.

Schedule and track annual preventive maintenance.

Assist CAM with Capital Expenditure (CapEx) projects and insurance claim administration.

 

4. Operations & Work Order Management:



Create and manage work orders and action items in Vantaca or designated systems.

Track completion and follow up on open tasks.

Coordinate move-in and move-out requests.

Address day-to-day operational issues impacting the property.

Key/fobs/clickers and entry systems request.

 

5. Compliance & Regulatory Tracking:



Support compliance efforts in all service areas by coordinating data collection, documentation, and delivery in partnership with the CAM and Compliance team.



Assist with statutory and jurisdictional requirements, including but not limited to:



Elevator certifications

Energy benchmarking

County registrations

Other jurisdiction-specific filings and inspections

Notify CAM of upcoming deadlines and compliance risks

 

6. Resale & Homeowner Support:



Assist the resale department by providing additional information and documentation as requested.

Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely responses to resale-related inquiries.

 

7. Documentation & Systems Management:



File and maintain accurate records in SharePoint and Vantaca including:



Contracts

Compliance records

Correspondence

Inspection reports

Draft letters

Meeting notices, proxies, and related materials

Forms, service tickets,



Ensure documents are properly stored and accessible in Sharepoint and Vantaca.

Follow standardized folder structures, naming conventions, and document retention guidelines.



Authority & Escalation:



ACMs operate within defined approval limits and SOP guidelines.

Strategic decisions, policy changes, and board-level recommendations are escalated to the CAM.

Issues impacting association risk, budget variance, or legal exposure must be escalated promptly.

 

Performance Expectations & KPIs:



 and inquiry response time: < 2 business hours.

On-time utility payments and invoice processing.

Accuracy of GL coding and financial reporting.

Compliance deadlines met with no lapses.

SOP adherence and training completion.

Positive feedback from CAMs and boards on responsiveness and reliability.

- Experience in the property management or real estate industry is required.

- Experience using Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Teams, etc.)

title: Director of Finance & Business Performance
description:
Job Type: Full-Time | Remote | Night Shift



About the Role



We're rebuilding the finance function of a multi-location food-service business, and we need an experienced finance leader who can personally lead the transformation — not just oversee or report on it.



This is not a traditional caretaker CFO or advisory role. You'll take ownership of the finance function, stabilize the essentials, identify what's not working, and rebuild the people, processes, systems, controls, reporting, and accountability needed for finance to become a reliable decision-making engine for the business.



You should be comfortable getting hands-on when needed — including stepping into accounting and finance operations while the function is being rebuilt.

Lead the complete finance function through a hands-on transition and transformation

Assess what is working, what is broken, and what needs to be redesigned

Restructure the finance team's roles, responsibilities, workflows, and accountability

Build accurate, controlled financial reporting and protect cash, payroll, and compliance

Own budgets, rolling forecasts, cash planning, and financial controls

Make profitability visible by location, brand, channel, and product

Build timely management information and leading indicators that help leadership identify problems early

Evaluate pricing, promotions, investments, and business decisions using clear financial and commercial analysis

Improve financial performance, cash management, forecasting, and overall business visibility

Build systems and processes that reduce dependence on individual people and create continuity when team members leave

Determine when people should be trained, reassigned, placed on performance plans, or replaced based on evidence and business needs

Introduce the right balance of AI and human resources to improve finance operations and decision-making

Develop a capable, self-sufficient finance team and eventually build a successor

10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, ideally at CFO, Finance Director, or equivalent senior level

Proven experience rebuilding, restructuring, or transforming a finance/accounting function

Strong hands-on experience across accounting, financial management, forecasting, cash, controls, and reporting

Track record of improving profitability, financial performance, forecasting, and cash management

Strong commercial instincts — including pricing, unit economics, promotions, investment analysis, and business cases

Ability to use financial and operational data to identify problems and drive better decisions

Experience redesigning teams, processes, systems, and responsibilities

Comfortable personally stepping into the work when necessary rather than operating purely at an advisory level

Advanced, hands-on use of AI and modern finance/technology tools

Professional finance/accounting qualification strongly preferred

Strong leadership, judgment, and ability to make difficult people and business decisions based on evidence

Bonus If You Have



Experience in complex multi-location hospitality, restaurant, food-service, or retail businesses

Experience managing finance across multiple brands, locations, or business units

Client-facing advisory or consulting experience

Experience building finance teams that can operate independently without constant executive intervention

A history of challenging executives with clear financial evidence and commercially grounded recommendations

See finance as a business decision-making tool, not just a compliance function

Enjoy walking into a messy or underperforming function and figuring out how to fix it

Are comfortable being both a strategic leader and hands-on operator

Like building systems, teams, and processes from the ground up

Care about developing people and creating a team that can succeed without depending on you

Are comfortable working with both people and AI-enabled systems

Want to leave the finance function stronger, more scalable, and more independent than you found it

title: Full-Time Video Editor for Ecommerce Brand
description:
Full-time, remote, long-term. Minimum 40 hours per week.



We are an ecommerce brand selling in Scandinavia, and we are looking for one video editor to work with us full-time and long-term. Not a project here and there. One person who makes our videos every week and gets better at it together with us.



The job is easy to explain and hard to do well. We send you the footage and the script. You turn it into short video ads that sell. They run on
, Instagram and TikTok, and the only question we ask about them is whether they brought in sales. After that we look at the numbers together, you tell us what you noticed, and the next batch gets better. That cycle is how Titan Kjokken grows. You are never on camera yourself; all of your work happens behind the scenes.



We need someone who has done this before. That means several years of editing, and several years in ecommerce. You have worked for online stores or dropshipping brands, and you understand how a product gets sold online. You know the difference between a video that looks nice and a video that makes someone buy. You work fast, and you keep the quality up when the volume goes up, because there will be volume.



Two more things that matter to us. You use AI tools every day and you are genuinely good with them: Claude, ChatGPT, Higgsfield, CapCut, whatever makes you quicker and sharper. And you can deliver Norwegian voice-overs and Norwegian text in your videos. You do not need to speak Norwegian yourself. You work from the scripts we give you and use AI voices for it.



If this sounds like you, send us a message with:



One video you edited that you are proud of. A link, plus a few lines about who it was for and what it achieved.

How many years you have been editing, and how many years you have worked in ecommerce.

Which editing programs and which AI tools you use.

How many hours per week you are available, and your time zone.

The name of our brand. We mention it once somewhere in this post, so we know you read it.

How the process works



We read every message that includes the points above. If we like what we see, we send you a follow-up message with a link to the next step. In there we explain the short test we ask you to do: what you get from us and what you have to edit. Based on the result of that test we d
 whether you are the right fit for us.



If you are, we get on a call, we go through everything together, and then it is settled. That is also the moment we tell you everything about us: the brand, the products, how we work and what your first weeks look like.



If you do not hear back from us, it means you did not make it to the next step. We get a lot of messages and we cannot reply to all of them, so please do not take it personally.



Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Meta Media Buyer: $500K+/Month Experience Required, Scaling DTC Portfolio to $100K/Day
description:
We run a portfolio of DTC Shopify brands in kids' supplements, wellness, and beauty. We're hiring a senior Meta media buyer to scale our accounts to $100,000/day in spend while keeping CPA under control.



The best media buyers think like day traders. They press when CPAs are winning, pull back fast when they aren't, and never let a bad day turn into a bad week. If that's how you already operate, read on.



What you'll own:



Full management of our Meta ad accounts across multiple brands: campaign architecture, budgets, bidding, and daily optimization

Actively managing spend against CPA, scaling up aggressively on winning days and cutting quickly when performance turns

Testing 100+ new ads per week from our in-house creative team and roster of ~20 creators, with a testing structure that finds winners fast and doesn't waste spend

Building account structures that work in the Andromeda era: creative diversity, consolidated campaigns, and broad targeting that lets the algorithm do its job

Diagnosing and fixing rising CPMs and bad CPA periods, whether the cause is creative fatigue, auction pressure, structure, tracking, or the offer

Running a tight feedback loop with our creative strategists: what's winning, why, and what we should make next

Prospecting, retargeting, and retention campaign setup

Daily performance snapshots and weekly reports that explain what happened, why, and what's next



Requirements:



Minimum $500K/month in Meta spend managed personally (not just "on the team"). Screenshots or case studies required.

Hands-on experience with how Andromeda changed account structure and creative testing

Experience in supplements, health, wellness, or beauty, and a strong understanding of Meta's ad policies for these categories

Proven ability to handle high creative volume (100+ ads/week) without losing control of the account

Strong grasp of unit economics (CPA, ROAS, MER, AOV, LTV). You make decisions on profitability, not just platform metrics.

Account risk management: backup BMs, ad account redundancy, and handling disapprovals and restrictions fast

Fast, clear communication with same-day responses and significant overlap with Eastern Time business hours

Comfort using AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and creative iteration



Nice to have:



Spend experience on TikTok, Google, YouTube

Experience with third-party attribution tools (Triple Whale, Northbeam, etc.)

Experience working directly alongside creative strategists and UGC creators



Engagement:

We're looking for a long-term partner and are open to a full-time role for the right person. Compensation will be a base plus performance bonus tied to hitting CPA targets at scale.



How to apply:

Start your proposal with the word "SCALE." Proposals without it will be skipped. Include screenshots of your highest-spend account (redact brand names if needed) and answer every question below.



Application Questions:



What's the highest monthly spend you've personally managed on Meta? What were the CPA and ROAS at that level, and what category was it?

Which channels besides Meta have you spent on, and at what monthly spend?

Which product categories have you run ads for? Have you managed supplement, health, or beauty brands, and how do you handle policy restrictions and account safety?

Walk us through your campaign structure for a brand spending $50K+/day: testing, scaling, and retargeting.

How has Andromeda changed the way you structure accounts and test creative? What did you stop doing, and what did you start doing?

How do you manage spend day to day against CPA? Give a specific example of when you scaled hard and when you cut hard, and what triggered each decision.

CPMs are up 30% week over week and CPA is climbing. Walk us through exactly how you diagnose it and what you do in the first 48 hours.

How would you structure testing for 100+ new ads per week without tanking account performance or wasting budget?

How do you work with creative strategists? What feedback do you give them, how often, and in what format?

What do your daily and weekly reports look like? Attach an example if possible.

Which AI tools do you use in your workflow, and for what specifically?

What's your desired compensation, and are you open to a full-time role?

What time zone are you in, and what hours do you work?

title: Senior Amazon PPC Manager - Own a $2M Ad Budget for an 8-Figure Food & Supplement Brand
description:
We're an 8-figure US protein food and supplement brand selling mainly on Amazon, with two brands in weight management. Small remote team, no layers.



We're hiring a **Senior Amazon PPC Manager** to fully own our Amazon ads - **six-figure monthly spend across Sponsored Products, Brands and Display**. You'll work hand in hand with our Amazon channel lead, who sets the targets (break-even and TACoS) and d
 which products to push. **You own the ad account and everything in it** - structure, bids, budgets, negatives - and you're in the console every day.



**Your goal is to hit the targets.** Finding problems and opportunities is your job, not your manager's. If he has to tell you a campaign is burning money, you've missed it. He approves your plans - he doesn't hand you instructions. That's why we're bringing PPC in-house.



**What you're walking into:** several hundred campaigns, most of the spend in a handful, and a long tail wasting money. Your first 90 days are a rebuild, not small tweaks. If that sounds exciting rather than painful, read on.



## 💼 What You'll Do



**Campaign Ownership**



- Own campaign architecture across Sponsored Products, Brands and Display for two brands

- Bids, budgets, placement modifiers, dayparting and match-type mix

- Keyword and ASIN harvesting from search-term data; negation at scale

- Keep spend on track with the monthly budget and move it between products within your break-even targets

- Consolidate and retire the campaign tail - a key goal for your first 90 days



**Finding Problems and Opportunities**



- Check the account daily against break-even targets and spend with no sales

- Cut or pause anything over its target **within 24 hours of the data showing it**, and log the change and the reason the same day

- Spot what's working and scale it

- Send a short daily update: what changed, why, what it did



**Product Launches - End to End**



- Build and run launch campaigns against a brief (budget, target CPC, rank goals, timeline)

- Own the week 2-3 conversion check and adjust bids and budgets based on it

- Report results against the launch plan



**Analysis**



- Work from our data stack - SellerLegend, Data Dive, and our internal AI agents that pull account and ad data

- Your job is to read the data and act, not to make reports



## 🧠 What You Bring



- **4+ years hands-on Amazon PPC**, with personal console time on accounts spending $100K+/month. You managed it yourself - not oversaw someone who did

- **A restructure you can describe with numbers** - campaign counts before and after, and what happened to TACoS and profit

- You work to **break-even and profit after ads**, not ACoS alone, and can explain when a high-ACoS campaign is the right call

- Keyword harvesting and negation at scale, with a clear system behind it - not one-off cleanups

- **Proactive** - you find the problem in the data and act, rather than waiting for direction

- Clear, short writing - your daily update should take 90 seconds to read

- Comfortable being measured on profit, not activity



## 🎯 Bonus if you:



- Have experience in CPG, supplements, functional foods, consumables or weight management

- Know SellerLegend, Data Dive, Helium 10 or Scale Insights

- Use AI tools (Claude/ChatGPT) to work faster and sharper - you'll work alongside our AI agents

- Have Amazon DSP or multi-marketplace experience (not required - the role is Amazon US only for now)

- Have Subscribe & Save or subscription-revenue experience

- Overlap with Philippines time zone (your manager is PH-based)



## 💸 What We Offer



- **$3,000-3,500/month**, contractor, fully remote - $3,000 during a 90-day provisional period, $3,500 on successful completion

- Real ownership from day one. You work inside agreed targets and you're trusted to move

- Direct daily work with the channel lead. No account managers, no middlemen

- A modern team that runs on AI tools, with the data to do the job properly

- Long-term role. We're bringing this in-house for good, not filling a gap



## 🚀 Ready to Apply?



Click the link below to fill out our questionnaire (20 min) and submit your resume. Only candidates who complete the questionnaire will move to the next stage.



We'd rather see real numbers from a messy account than polished answers. If you have screenshots or a portfolio that back up what you've done, include them - it made the difference for the last person we hired.

title: Virtual Production Coordinator — Construction / Outdoor Living
description:
A growing outdoor-living construction company is hiring a full-time Virtual Production Coordinator to help move sold projects from sales handoff to production-ready.



This is not a generic VA role and not a field Project Manager role. You will support the Project Manager by organizing scopes, estimates, plans, selections, photos, permits, material orders, work orders, vendor documents, and project folders so each sold job is ready before scheduling.



Pay / schedule: full time, 40 hours per week, paid weekly.



Note: All applicants must include a short intro video (60 seconds to 2 minutes). Read instructions below.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Review sold project information: contracts, estimates, plans, selections, photos, and notes.

Identify missing information or decisions that could delay production.

Prepare work orders and subcontractor scope documents from approved project information.

Prepare material takeoffs, material order forms, purchase orders, and vendor documentation as directed.

Prepare and submit permit applications as authorized; track approvals, inspections, and municipal requirements.

Organize project documents and keep production folders/status updated.

Follow up with the Project Manager, suppliers, subcontractors, or local offices when information is missing.

Help confirm whether each project is truly production-ready before it is scheduled.



STRONG FIT



Construction admin, project coordination, estimating, purchasing, permitting, remodeling, outdoor living, exteriors, landscaping/hardscapes, or similar experience.

Able to read scopes, estimates, plans, specifications, and project documents.

Very organized, detail-oriented, persistent with follow-up, and clear in written English.

Comfortable with spreadsheets, PDFs, online forms, project-management software, construction software, vendor portals, and permitting websites.



ROLE BOUNDARY



The Project Manager owns field execution and project decisions. This role owns administrative readiness: documents, work orders, procurement support, permits, follow-up, and completeness. You will not be responsible for unsupervised engineering, code interpretation, contractor licensing, or field construction decisions.



TO APPLY



Put READY in the first line of your application.



Then answer:



1. What construction, remodeling, project coordination, purchasing, estimating, or permitting experience do you have?

2. What software/tools have you used for project coordination, spreadsheets, PDFs, vendor portals, permits, or construction management?

3. Have you prepared work orders, material orders, purchase orders, permit applications, or project handoff documents before? Briefly explain.

4. How would you organize the handoff of a newly sold construction project from Sales to Production? Include scope review, missing information, work orders, materials, permits, procurement, and a production-ready check.

5. Are you okay with working around US EST hours, and what's your earliest start date?



6. Required intro video (60 seconds to 2 minutes): Record a short video introducing yourself and explaining your qualifications and why you believe you're a strong fit for this position. Include a link to the video (Loom, Google Drive, etc.) in your application, and make sure the link is viewable without requesting access. Applications without a video will not be considered.

title: HR Assistant
description:
ABOUT US

IV Concierge is a Florida-based mobile healthcare and wellness company dedicated to making high-quality healthcare more accessible, convenient, and personalized. QUALIFICATIONS

Experience supporting or managing full-cycle recruitment for U.S.-based companies; healthcare, medical, wellness, or regulated-industry experience is strongly preferred.

Strong follow-up skills and consistent attention to process details

Positive, collaborative, and committed to helping build a strong team

WHY JOIN IV CONCIERGE

description:

About the Role

This role is ideal for someone who understands that great social media content is about more than simply editing a video. You should know how to capture attention, maintain viewer retention, create strong hooks, and package content in a way that makes people want to click and watch.



You’ll primarily work with video footage that we provide and turn it into engaging YouTube videos and short-form content for platforms such as YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
.



We’re especially interested in someone who understands how YouTube works and can contribute ideas about what makes content perform, how to improve retention, and how to grow a channel over time.







About AppAid



AppAid is a dedicated Social Security advocacy group committed to assisting individuals with disabilities who are unable to work full-time. Our mission is to guide and support clients through the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) application and claims process, ensuring they receive the benefits they deserve.



As our company continues to grow, we’re investing in our digital presence to expand our YouTube and social media channels and reach more people with helpful, engaging content about the disability benefits process. We’re looking for talented individuals to help us grow that audience and support our continued growth.





What You'll Do

Edit engaging YouTube videos and short-form social media content



Turn raw footage into compelling, polished videos designed to maximize viewer retention



Identify strong moments, hooks, and storylines within longer footage



Create engaging openings that capture attention within the first few seconds



Add captions, graphics, B-roll, sound effects, music, zooms, transitions, and other elements when appropriate



Create high-click-through-rate YouTube thumbnails



Develop multiple thumbnail or title concepts when appropriate



Repurpose longer videos into Shorts, TikToks, Reels, and other social content



Adapt editing styles and formats for different platforms



Help identify trends, formats, and content opportunities that could help grow the channel



Collaborate with our team on video concepts, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and overall content strategy



Stay up to date with YouTube and short-form video trends within the Social Security Disability niche





What We're Looking For/Required:

Strong video editing skills



Experience editing content specifically for YouTube/Shorts and/or social media



Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and viewer retention



Ability to create professional and attention-grabbing thumbnails



Strong visual and creative instincts



Ability to take raw footage and identify the most engaging moments



Ability to receive and implement feedback promptly, making requested revisions accurately and within a reasonable timeframe



Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Strong attention to detail



Strongly Preferred:



Demonstrated experience using video editing and content strategy to grow a YouTube channel, including measurable improvements in views, watch time, subscribers, or engagement

Experience developing YouTube thumbnails



Experience with A/B testing or experimenting with different hooks, titles, thumbnails, or editing styles



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, Photoshop, or similar tools







The ideal candidate is creative, curious, and focused on results. They should be able to look at a piece of footage and think:



"What is going to make someone stop scrolling?"

"What will make them keep watching?"

"What's the strongest moment in this footage?"

"How can we package this so someone wants to click?"



You should be comfortable bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you think a particular edit, hook, thumbnail, or format could perform better.





As part of the application process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short editing exercise using raw footage provided by us. The exercise will involve creating a 15–30 second social media video so we can better understand your editing style, creativity, pacing, and ability to create an engaging hook.



Only applicants who submit their information here will be considered for interview:

description:
About Park Ave Appliance

Park Ave Appliance is an online major-appliance retailer based in New Jersey, selling refrigerators, ranges, washers, dryers, dishwashers and more through 
. These are high-ticket purchases. Our customers want to talk to someone who truly understands the product and can close the sale, while keeping up in a fast-paced environment where several things are happening at once.

The job

You are the salesperson for our website. Most of your day is spent talking with shoppers who have not bought yet, by chat, phone and
, answering their questions, guiding them to the right product and turning the conversation into an order. The rest is making sure every order that comes in goes through cleanly.

• Chat and speak with shoppers who are still d
. Answer questions, compare models, overcome hesitation and close the sale. This is the heart of the job.

• Follow up with shoppers who asked a question or left items in their cart and bring them back to buy.

• Offer the right add-ons and upgrades: protection plans, installation, haul-away, the matching piece, the better model when it fits.

• Review and process every incoming web order the same day: address, stock, pricing and delivery options.

• Call or

• Learn the product. Within 60 days you should be able to walk a customer through choosing a refrigerator without looking anything up.

This is not an order-entry job. You will make decisions every day without asking. When a situation is not covered by a procedure, you figure out the right thing, do it, and tell us. Someone who waits to be told what to do will not be happy here.

Who we are looking for

• 5+ years in sales or customer-facing work by phone and chat. E-commerce, retail, appliances, furniture or electronics experience is a plus.

• Excellent spoken and written English: clear, confident and natural with American customers, no scripts.

• A natural salesperson who enjoys talking to people and knows how to move a hesitant shopper to a decision.

• Fast and organized. You can hold several chats and an order queue at the same time without dropping anything.

• A problem solver who takes initiative and finishes what they start.

• Comfortable working in Shopify and standard
 and chat tools.

• Available for the full schedule below.

Pay

title: Content Marketing & Social Media Designer
description:
About Heads Up:

Heads Up is a UK leadership development business that helps primary school headteachers move their schools from good to great.



Our founder, Sonia Gill, is a school leadership expert, speaker and trainer. Our work includes leadership programmes (Journey to Great), a headteacher Mastermind group, training on Successful Difficult Conversations, and a weekly leadership tips
 read by school leaders across the UK.



Our audience is busy, intelligent and experienced. Our content needs to feel practical, human and authoritative — never corporate, never salesy, never influencer-style.



About the role:

We're looking for a part-time content marketer with strong design skills to turn Sonia's ideas into content that builds trust with headteachers and brings in relevant enquiries.



Heads Up already has a lot of valuable material: weekly
s, articles, conference talks, webinars, school stories and videos. Your job is to look at a piece of that material and ask:



-What is the strongest idea here?

-What could it become, and in which format?

-How can we get several useful pieces of content from it?

-What is likely to work on each platform?

-What is the response telling us?

-How does this help a headteacher take the next step with Heads Up?



Then you make it: well-designed graphics, carousels and short video clips, with captions drafted in Sonia's voice.



This is not a role where you wait to be told exactly what to make. We want someone who understands the material, makes good decisions and comes back with strong ideas and finished work. Sonia remains the expert and the voice; you help her ideas reach more of the right people.



What you'll do:



Content thinking and repurposing:

-Review Heads Up source material each week and pick out the strongest ideas

-Turn one piece of source material into several content assets across our channels

-Propose new content ideas from our back catalogue of talks, webinars and
s



Design and video:

-Create branded social graphics, carousels, quote cards and lead-magnet visuals

-Edit short video clips from talks and webinars, with accurate captions

-Design internal materials such as slide decks (around 10% of your time)

-Work within Heads Up's brand guidelines and voice, keeping our visual style consistent and high quality across everything we publish

-Set up and manage Heads Up's own licensed design and music accounts (such as Canva), use only properly licensed images, music, fonts and video, and keep a simple record of where each asset came from



Copy:

-Draft social captions and carousel text in Sonia's voice, for her approval

-Proofread everything carefully — accuracy matters to our audience



Platforms and performance:

-Adapt content for each channel. LinkedIn is our main platform. We also want to be visible on Instagram, especially through reels, with
 and YouTube as supporting channels

-Use hooks, formats and calls to action that suit each platform and our professional audience, and schedule finished posts in Loomly (as drafts for approval during your first month)

-Write a short monthly review: what worked, what didn't and what you'll change next month

-Recommend changes to our approach, including dropping a channel if the data shows it isn't working



Leads and relationships:

-Create content that encourages headteachers to sign up to Sonia's weekly leadership tips
 and our free lead magnets

-Support our wider aim of turning attention into conversations and enquiries



What this role isn't:

To be clear about where the role starts and stops:

-Not community management. Our assistant handles connections, replies, comments and day-to-day account management.

-Not the voice of Heads Up. You'll draft in Sonia's voice, but her ideas, positions and frameworks stay hers.

-Not paid advertising, SEO or website building.

-Not trend-chasing. We value clear, useful content over viral tactics.



What we're looking for:



Essential:

-3+ years creating content for B2B, professional-services, coaching, consulting or education brands

-Clear evidence that your content has led to enquiries, sign-ups or clients, not just likes and followers

-Strong editorial judgement: you can spot the best idea in a long piece of content and explain why it works

-Genuine design skill: strong typography, layout and consistency across a series, beyond basic Canva templates

-Short-form video editing: clean cuts, clear captions, good pacing

-Able to work within an existing brand and adapt your style to it

-A clear understanding of copyright and licensing for images, music and fonts in commercial content

-Excellent written English, with close attention to spelling, grammar and accuracy

-Good understanding of LinkedIn and how professional audiences behave online

-Reliable: you meet deadlines and tell us early if something is at risk

-Able to work independently and come back with ideas, not just questions



Nice to have:

-Experience working with UK clients or the UK education sector

-Experience working with a founder or expert whose voice is the brand

-Motion graphics or animation

-Figma or Adobe Creative Suite, as well as Canva

-Basic understanding of SEO



If you're strong in content and design but less experienced in video, we still want to hear from you.



How we'll measure success:

We judge content by what it leads to, not by likes.



Ongoing (in your monthly review):

1. Sign-ups from social to the weekly tips
 and our lead magnets

2. Enquiries or discovery calls that came via social

3. Clicks from social to our website

4. Meaningful engagement: LinkedIn comments, shares and saves; Instagram reel views, saves and shares

5. Work delivered on time, accurate and on brand



During the 3-month trial:

-Reliable: on time, no text errors, on brand, with little correction needed by month 3

-Independent: you bring strong ideas rather than waiting to be told what to make

-Quality: design and social content we're proud to publish

-Early signal: sign-ups and engagement trending up from where we started



Hours, pay and trial:

Hours: 16 hours per week, Monday to Thursday, at fixed times so you're available when the team is working. We'd like to increase hours over time if the role works well.



Day: Monday–Thursday

Hours: 4 each



Monday includes a weekly 1:1 with Sonia, held on Monday morning (UK time).



Pay: PHP 30,000 per month, fixed monthly fee, depending on experience and portfolio.



Trial: 3 months, with a review at the end. For the first month, Sonia will review all work and give guidance on brand and style. After that, you'll have more freedom to publish within agreed guidelines.



Commitment: This role needs to be a genuine priority. Other part-time clients on non-overlapping hours are fine, but this role isn't suitable if you have a full-time job elsewhere.



Start date: TBC



How to apply:



Please send:

1. A link to your portfolio, including 3–5 examples of content for professional or B2B audiences

2. One short piece for Heads Up. Take one of Sonia's posts on LinkedIn or a tip from 
/weeklytips and turn it into either one social graphic or a short carousel (up to 5 slides), using the style and colours on our website. Watermark it if you like: this is to see how you apply our brand, not to get free work. It should take no more than an hour. Add 2–3 sentences on why you chose that idea and format.

3. Your other current work and the hours you do it

4. A short answer (under 150 words): what makes content for school leaders different from content for a general audience?



Please start your application with the words "Good to Great" so we know you've read this in full.



Selection process:

1. Shortlist based on portfolio and application

2. Shortlisted candidates create one short reel (30–60 seconds, with captions) from a clip of Sonia that we provide. Watermark it if you like.

3. Video interview with Sonia

4. 3-month trial



Application deadline: 9:00am GMT, Monday 19 October 2026.

title: MEDICAL BILLER — ARBITRATION PAYMENT FOLLOW-UP
description:
We are hiring two experienced medical billers to follow up on outstanding payments for our arbitration department.

This role focuses on payer follow-up and collection tracking for claims handled through the U.S. federal Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) process. We need persistent, organized billers who document clearly and follow each account through resolution.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Review assigned claims and arbitration outcomes to identify outstanding payments.

• Contact insurance companies by phone, portal, and written correspondence.

• Confirm payment status, amounts, payment references, and expected payment dates.

• Investigate missing, partial, or incorrectly applied payments.

• Coordinate with payment-posting staff to verify receipt and reconcile balances.

• Maintain accurate follow-up notes and schedule the next action for every open account.

• Escalate delayed or disputed payments with supporting documentation.

• Report collections, unresolved balances, and payer obstacles.



QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in U.S. medical billing, accounts receivable, or insurance collections.

• Strong payer follow-up and telephone communication skills.

• Ability to interpret EOBs and ERAs and investigate payment discrepancies.

• Strong spreadsheet and documentation skills.

• Arbitration or No Surprises Act experience preferred.

• eClinicalWorks experience is a plus.



WORK REQUIREMENTS

Remote position based in the Philippines, with availability during U.S. Eastern business hours, reliable internet, and a private workspace.



COMPENSATION

Salary: Based on experience



TO APPLY

Please submit your résumé and briefly answer the following:



1. How many years of experience do you have in U.S. medical billing, accounts receivable, or insurance collections?

2. Which insurance payers have you worked with?

3. Describe your experience following up on unpaid, delayed, partial, or incorrectly applied payments.

4. Do you have experience with arbitration, the No Surprises Act, or the federal IDR process? If yes, please describe.

5. Which billing, EMR/EHR, or payer systems have you used?

6. Give one example of a difficult outstanding claim or payment issue you successfully followed through to resolution.

title: AI Video Editor
description:

Right now our concepts are outpacing our hands. Our creative strategist builds the scripts, hooks and angles off real performance data, so the thinking is done. We need someone who can take those concepts and turn them into scroll stopping and converting AI video ads.



It's for someone who owns the craft of AI video and get sharper every single week.



What you'll do

- Turn concepts and scripts from our creative strategist into finished direct-response video ads for Meta

- Live in AI video: AI animated ads, AI UGC, AI talking-head and avatar ads, AI b-roll, mixed with real footage where that lands harder

- Most editors grab b-roll that's vaguely on-topic and the ad dies. You won't.

- Iterate fast off performance data. What won, what died, and why, every week.

- Test new AI tools before anyone else. New models drop every month and I want you on them first.

- Spot what's working and scale it. When a concept wins, we make more of it.



Why this seat is different

- You see the data. You get access to all our performance numbers, so you always know what's working and why.

- Weekly call with your lead. We go through your ads together, you get direct feedback, and you level up off it. No guessing.

- We pay for your tools. Every AI tool and subscription you need is on us. Find a new one that makes you faster or better? Tell us and we'll get it.



Full-time, long-term. We want someone in the business with us.



Where this can lead

Editor → Editor Lead → (if it's really in you) Creative Strategist.



Every step is a pay rise, based on performance. If you start thinking about why an ad works, not just how to cut it, you'll move fast.



You'll thrive here if

- You already live in AI video tools and get excited when a new model drops

None of those people last here.

I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar & Email Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to email & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and email service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including Email and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $400-$500 USD a month ($4800 - $6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Sales Administrator & Customer Support
description:
Sales Administrator & Customer Support

Remote: Philippines-based

Department: Sales / Customer Operations

Working with: Sales, NPD, Technical, Operations & Finance Teams



About the Company



Simple Company is the white-label and contract manufacturing arm of STYRKR, working with brands to develop and manufacture high-quality sports nutrition products.



We work with customers internationally, supporting projects from initial development and sampling through to production and delivery.



This is a long-term remote opportunity for someone who enjoys working with customers, managing detailed administration, and coordinating multiple projects across different teams.

About the Role



We are looking for a Sales Administrator & Customer Support person to support our growing white-label manufacturing business.



This is a highly organised, coordination-focused role. You will be responsible for helping customers move smoothly through the ordering and production process, while ensuring that our internal systems, documentation, and project information are accurate and up to date.



You will work closely with the Sales, NPD, Technical, Operations, and Finance teams to make sure customer orders and development projects progress on time.



This role is ideal for someone who is:

- Highly organised and detail-oriented

- Confident communicating with customers

- Comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines

- Proactive about following up and chasing information

- Good at spotting missing information or potential issues

- Comfortable with repetitive administrative tasks and accurate data entry

- Able to work independently in a remote environment

- Interested in learning about manufacturing, product development, and international B2B sales



Key Responsibilities



Order & Project Processing

- Receive and review customer purchase orders

- Check pricing and quantities against approved quotations

- Confirm minimum order quantities and production quantities

- Raise sales, sample, and development orders in NetSuite

- Send order confirmations to customers

- Monitor payment requirements and coordinate with Finance

- Track customer orders from receipt through production to delivery

- Arrange delivery or collection of completed orders

- Provide customers with invoices, credit notes, and proof of delivery

- Ensure all order information is accurate and complete before processing



Customer & Project Administration

- Set up new customers and relevant information in NetSuite

- Create and maintain customer projects in 

- Maintain accurate customer contacts, commercial terms, and delivery information

- Keep records of approved quotations, product specifications, and artwork

- Track customer-supplied ingredients and packaging

- Record customer approvals, feedback, and requested changes

- Check whether specifications, formulations, or artwork have changed before repeat orders

- Keep customer and project records organised and up to date



Customer Support & Coordination

- Act as the first point of contact for routine customer order and project queries

- Provide proactive updates on product development, samples, production, and delivery

- Coordinate sample requests with NPD and Technical teams

- Track formulation, flavour, specification, and artwork approvals

- Monitor raw-material and packaging availability

- Coordinate packaging, printing, and artwork requirements

- Request customer forecasts and expected production requirements

- Follow up on outstanding information, approvals, and documents

- Identify missing information or approvals that could delay production

- Escalate delays, pricing issues, production concerns, and commercial risks to the relevant team

- Coordinate between Sales, NPD, Technical, Operations, and Finance

- Produce regular reports covering samples, development projects, quotations, open orders, and production status



Systems & Tools



You will work across a number of business systems and online tools, including:

- NetSuite – customer records, sales orders, samples, invoices and order tracking

- 
 – project management and customer development tracking

- Google Workspace –
, documents, spreadsheets and reporting

- Other internal systems used for production, logistics and customer management

- Full training will be provided on our systems and processes.



The successful candidate will be expected to:

- Keep customer and order information accurate and up to date

- Respond to customer queries promptly and professionally

- Complete order administration accurately and on time

- Proactively follow up on outstanding information and approvals

- Keep projects and orders moving forward without unnecessary delays

- Identify and escalate issues before they become larger problems

- Maintain clear and organised records across all systems

- Communicate effectively with both customers and internal teams

- Clear KPIs, processes, and training will be provided.



Qualifications & Experience

- Previous experience in sales administration, customer service, order processing, sales support, virtual assistance, or administration

- Strong written and spoken English

- Excellent attention to detail

- Strong organisational and time-management skills

- Comfortable working with spreadsheets and online systems

- Confident communicating with customers by
 and messaging platforms

- Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously

- Comfortable following processes and completing detailed administrative work

- Proactive approach to follow-ups and problem solving

- Able to work independently and reliably in a remote environment



Nice to Have – Not Required

- Experience working with international customers

- Experience supporting B2B customers or wholesale accounts

- Experience with NetSuite, 
, Shopify, or other ERP/CRM systems

title: Video Editor for Health & Wellness Brand (Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
We're looking for a passionate Video Editor to join Laviva Health, a global Functional Medicine brand.



We're ready to start immediately, with the opportunity for a long-term relationship if we're a great fit. The position will be project based in start and may lead to long term full time position.



What You'll Edit:



* Short-form and long-form educational videos

* Podcast episodes

* Social media content (shorts, reels)



Our content covers Functional Medicine topics such as gut health, thyroid, adrenal health, hormones, inflammation, chronic health conditions, and overall wellness.



Who We're Looking For:



We're looking for someone who understands that great editing is about more than cutting clips, it's about capturing attention, keeping viewers engaged, and communicating ideas clearly.



You should:



* Have experience editing for health, wellness, or medical brands/creators

* Know how to use relevant medical and health B-roll effectively

* Understand audience psychology and retention

* Be a good listener and observer

Screening Questions Must be Answered, The proposal that didn't answer the questions will be completely ignored:

title: Remote Land Analyst for US Land Company (US Hours, Full Time)
description:
Flaghaven Land buys and sells vacant land in the United States. We're hiring a full-time remote analyst to evaluate lots: pull sold comps, check zoning and utilities in county GIS, and figure out what a lot is really worth to a home builder.



WHAT YOU GET

- $600 to $800 USD per month, plus a $150 bonus for every closed deal you analyzed

- Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 6 AM Philippine time from November)

- Full training on our process

- Start: early November



WHAT YOU NEED

- Clear spoken English. We have calls with our US team every day.

- Your own computer, stable internet, and a backup for outages (UPS, generator, or a second internet provider)

- Care with details. Small mistakes cost real money in this job.

- BIG PLUS: experience working for US land flippers or real estate wholesalers, and with tools like Land Insights, LandPortal, Smarter Contact, DataTree, PropStream, or county GIS/parcel maps. Engineering, surveying, GIS, or real estate background also a plus.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word PARCEL. Applications without it are not reviewed.

2. Include a link to a 1 to 2 minute video (Loom, unlisted YouTube, or Google Drive) about who you are. Speak naturally, do not read from a script.

3. Tell us which land or real estate tools you have used (Land Insights, LandPortal, Smarter Contact, etc.) and for how long.



Shortlisted applicants get a short application form, then a paid $25 work sample and a call.

title: Amazon Brand Sourcing Specialist

Find brand owners, manufacturers, and authorized distributors

Introduce our company and establish wholesale partnerships

title: Multimedia Video Editor
description:
Location: Remote



Rate: $6 - $8/hour



Employment Type: Contractor



Schedule:

7:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time (PST),

Monday - Friday (Full time - 8 hours - 1 hour lunch break)

**Candidates must be available to work these hours based on our headquarters’ time zone.





About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Video Editor & YouTube Growth Specialist to help us grow our YouTube channel and expand our content across social media platforms.



This role is ideal for someone who understands that great social media content is about more than simply editing a video. You should know how to capture attention, maintain viewer retention, create strong hooks, and package content in a way that makes people want to click and watch.



You’ll primarily work with video footage that we provide and turn it into engaging YouTube videos and short-form content for platforms such as YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
.



We’re especially interested in someone who understands how YouTube works and can contribute ideas about what makes content perform, how to improve retention, and how to grow a channel over time.







About AppAid



AppAid is a dedicated Social Security advocacy group committed to assisting individuals with disabilities who are unable to work full-time. Our mission is to guide and support clients through the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) application and claims process, ensuring they receive the benefits they deserve.



As our company continues to grow, we’re investing in our digital presence to expand our YouTube and social media channels and reach more people with helpful, engaging content about the disability benefits process. We’re looking for talented individuals to help us grow that audience and support our continued growth.





What You'll Do

Edit engaging YouTube videos and short-form social media content



Turn raw footage into compelling, polished videos designed to maximize viewer retention



Identify strong moments, hooks, and storylines within longer footage



Create engaging openings that capture attention within the first few seconds



Add captions, graphics, B-roll, sound effects, music, zooms, transitions, and other elements when appropriate



Create high-click-through-rate YouTube thumbnails



Develop multiple thumbnail or title concepts when appropriate



Repurpose longer videos into Shorts, TikToks, Reels, and other social content



Adapt editing styles and formats for different platforms



Help identify trends, formats, and content opportunities that could help grow the channel



Collaborate with our team on video concepts, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and overall content strategy



Stay up to date with YouTube and short-form video trends within the Social Security Disability niche





What We're Looking For/Required:

Strong video editing skills



Experience editing content specifically for YouTube/Shorts and/or social media



Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and viewer retention



Ability to create professional and attention-grabbing thumbnails



Strong visual and creative instincts



Ability to take raw footage and identify the most engaging moments



Ability to receive and implement feedback promptly, making requested revisions accurately and within a reasonable timeframe



Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Strong attention to detail



Strongly Preferred:



Demonstrated experience using video editing and content strategy to grow a YouTube channel, including measurable improvements in views, watch time, subscribers, or engagement

Experience developing YouTube thumbnails



Experience with A/B testing or experimenting with different hooks, titles, thumbnails, or editing styles



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, Photoshop, or similar tools







The ideal candidate is creative, curious, and focused on results. They should be able to look at a piece of footage and think:



"What is going to make someone stop scrolling?"

"What will make them keep watching?"

"What's the strongest moment in this footage?"

"How can we package this so someone wants to click?"



You should be comfortable bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you think a particular edit, hook, thumbnail, or format could perform better.





As part of the application process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short editing exercise using raw footage provided by us. The exercise will involve creating a 15–30 second social media video so we can better understand your editing style, creativity, pacing, and ability to create an engaging hook.



Only applicants who submit their information here will be considered for interview:

title: CREATIVE STRATEGIST – DTC JEWELRY BRAND
description:
We are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist to take ownership of creative strategy for a fast-growing DTC jewelry brand.



This is not a junior role and not just a scriptwriting position.



You will be responsible for building and running a structured creative system across:



Customer and competitor research



Creative angles and concepts



Hooks and scripts



UGC and video ad direction



Static/image ad concepts



Creative briefs for editors



Reviewing finished creatives



Meta creative performance analysis



Feedback loops



Iterations of winners and high-potential ads



Creative organization and documentation



FEEDBACK LOOPS & SYSTEMS



We want someone highly organized who can build and maintain a proper creative feedback loop.



Every ad should move through a clear system such as:



Concept → Production → Launched → Performance Review → Winner / High Potential / Loser → Iteration / Graveyard



We want creative decisions based on data, not gut feeling.



You should be comfortable analyzing metrics such as ROAS, CPA, CTR, hook rate, hold rate, watch time and conversion performance, then diagnosing exactly what should be improved.



Iterations should be intentional and based on clear hypotheses.



RESEARCH



You should be strong at manual customer research and also know how to use AI to improve and accelerate your work.



Research may include:



Customer reviews



Post-purchase surveys



Meta comments



Competitor ads



Reddit/forums/social media



Customer support conversations



Existing winning and losing creatives



We use AI heavily, but we do not want someone who simply asks ChatGPT for random angles and calls that strategy.



EMOTIONAL STORYTELLING



We are a jewelry brand, so emotional storytelling is mandatory.



You need to understand how to turn customer emotions, identity, relationships, faith, gifting, love, meaning and personal values into direct-response ads that actually convert.



Experience with jewelry, beauty, fashion, gifting, lifestyle or other emotionally driven DTC brands is a major plus.



TEAM



You will work closely with the founder and our current creative team.



We already have 2 video editors ready to work under your direction, and we expect you to help improve them through clear briefs, feedback and creative direction.



If you already have video editors you strongly prefer working with, we are also open to discussing bringing them into the team.



This is negotiable.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



Strong DTC / ecommerce creative strategy experience



Meta advertising creative experience



Strong direct-response copywriting skills



Experience analyzing creative performance



Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling and customer psychology



Experience directing video editors



Experience with UGC and static ads



Strong organizational and systems skills



Experience building creative feedback loops



Excellent communication



Ability to work independently and take ownership



You should be proactive and easy to communicate with.



We want someone who can eventually come to us with:



What worked, what failed, what we learned, what we should iterate, and what we should test next.





We are looking for someone who wants to become deeply involved with one brand and help build a high-performance creative department.

title: Daily Bookkeeper / E-commerce Finance Assistant – Remote, Part-Time
description:
# Daily Bookkeeper / E-commerce Finance Assistant – Remote, Part-Time



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented **Bookkeeper / E-commerce Finance Assistant** to manage the daily financial records of two growing e-commerce businesses operating in the **UK and USA**.



This is a long-term remote position requiring approximately **1–2 hours per day**.



The main objective of the role is simple: **by the end of each business day, we want to know the true net profit generated by each business that day.**



You will also be responsible for maintaining organised financial records, filing invoices and supporting documents, and ensuring transactions can be easily traced and reconciled.



## Main Responsibilities



### Daily Profit Calculation



At the end of each working day, calculate the net profit separately for each business.



This will involve reviewing and reconciling:



- Daily Shopify sales

- Refunds and cancellations

- Cost of goods sold (COGS)

- Supplier invoices and actual product costs

- Payment processing fees

- Shopify fees

- PayPal and other payment transactions

- Advertising expenses

- Shipping/freight costs where applicable

- Other operating expenses



You should be able to clearly report:



**Revenue – COGS – Transaction Fees – Advertising – Other Direct Expenses = Net Profit**



The calculation must be based on the actual underlying transactions rather than simply looking at cash entering or leaving the bank account.



### Order-Level Reconciliation



Our businesses sell relatively high-value products, with many orders fulfilled directly by suppliers.



You may therefore need to:



- Match customer orders to supplier invoices

- Identify the actual supplier cost associated with each order

- Track orders awaiting supplier invoices

- Identify refunds and cancellations

- Flag discrepancies between Shopify, supplier records and payments

- Maintain a list of unresolved transactions requiring management review



**Accuracy is more important than guessing.** If the cost or treatment of a transaction cannot be confirmed, it should be flagged rather than assumed.



### Invoice & Document Management



You will also be responsible for keeping our accounting documentation organised.



This includes:



- Downloading and filing supplier invoices

- Filing supplier credit notes

- Organising receipts

- Organising statements

- Matching invoices to orders where possible

- Maintaining organised folders by company, supplier, month and document type

- Ensuring supporting documentation can be easily located when required



Our objective is to maintain clean financial records that can later be provided to our accountants without having to reconstruct transactions months later.



## Daily Reporting



At the end of each day, we expect a short financial summary for each business showing:



**Power and Pedal – UK**

- Revenue

- COGS

- Gross Profit

- Fees

- Advertising / Direct Expenses

- Other relevant expenses

- Net Profit

- Net Margin %

- Any unresolved transactions or missing invoices



**Build the Power – USA**

- Revenue

- COGS

- Gross Profit

- Fees

- Advertising / Direct Expenses

- Other relevant expenses

- Net Profit

- Net Margin %

- Any unresolved transactions or missing invoices



The reporting system and templates will be provided and developed together.



## Working Hours



- Approximately **1–2 hours per day**

- Remote position

- Monday to Saturday

- Flexible working time, but the daily report must be completed at the agreed time each day

title: Global Product Sourcing Specialist
description:
An Oman-based e-commerce business is looking for an experienced sourcing professional to find, verify and compare suppliers worldwide (not limited to China, Asia or the Americas) and confirm products can legally ship to Oman at a clear Landed Cost. Project-based / as-needed, with long-term potential.



This is NOT a customer service, fulfillment or general VA role. We give you a product name, photo or specification. You start from zero and work independently.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Find manufacturers, authorized distributors, wholesalers and exporters globally, and label each supplier's type

- Verify suppliers and reduce counterfeit / grey-market risk

- Compare 3+ suppliers per product and negotiate price, MOQ, samples, lead time and payment terms

- Request required documents (COA, SDS, ingredient list, GMP, certificate of origin)

- Check shipping feasibility to Oman with freight forwarders, including restrictions

- Calculate Landed Cost per unit and deliver a short sourcing report



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years of direct sourcing / procurement experience (5+ preferred)

- Experience in skincare, cosmetics, beauty or personal care

- Able to source outside China and Alibaba. Experience in every country is not required; the ability to research new markets is

- Clear understanding of manufacturer vs distributor vs trading company

- Practical knowledge of Incoterms and Landed Cost

- Freight forwarder experience

- Strong negotiation and excellent written English



PLUS: perfumes and liquids, restricted-shipping products, GCC experience, Private Label / OEM.



PRODUCTS WE SOURCE: skincare (serums, creams, cleansers), cosmetics, hair and body care, perfumes and fragrances, men's and women's vitality and wellness supplements, and intimate wellness products (such as lubricants and wellness devices). The last category is regulated and compliance-sensitive, so ingredients, import, customs and shipping requirements are checked before any purchase. All work must follow applicable laws. We never ask anyone to bypass restrictions.



APPLICATION STEPS (MANDATORY)

1. To confirm you have read this posting in full, end your application message on OnlineJobs.ph with the word "one", and repeat it in any follow-up message you send us.

2. After applying, send a WhatsApp message to 
containing the job title followed by the word one, and nothing else.

3. In your application message, address the following points, supported by specific examples from your past work:

   - Your years of sourcing experience, and the products and countries you have personally sourced from
