   - How you verify that a supplier is legitimate

   - What you include when calculating Landed Cost

   - Your expected rate and availability

4. Attach a short task (1 page): 3 suppliers for a 30 ml private-label Vitamin C serum, from at least 2 countries, one of them outside Asia and North America, and explain how you verified each supplier.



Applicants who do not complete every step (including the word "one") will not be contacted. Generic answers will not be considered. A previous client reference may be requested at the final stage. All information is kept confidential.

s and text messages when necessary.

Preferred Qualifications

What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINKELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: QA Legal Assistant
description:
About the Opportunity



Are you a detail-driven legal professional with an exceptional eye for accuracy and a commitment to getting every detail right?

We are seeking a QA Legal Assistant to serve as a critical quality-control resource within our legal department. This role is ideal for someone who naturally catches inconsistencies, notices missing details others overlook, and takes pride in producing accurate, organized, and compliant work.

As a QA Legal Assistant, you will work behind the scenes to review, verify, and audit legal documentation, case files, administrative workflows, and critical deadlines before information moves forward.

Your attention to detail will help protect the firm from preventable errors, maintain compliance standards, and ensure our attorneys and legal teams have accurate information they can rely on.

If you thrive in an environment where precision, organization, consistency, and accountability matter, this could be an excellent opportunity for you.



Key Responsibilities



Legal Document Quality Control

- Review, proofread, and audit legal filings, contracts, correspondence, and other legal documents for accuracy and completeness.

- Verify names, dates, case information, attachments, citations, formatting, and other critical details.

- Maintain a high standard of accuracy and ensure documents are ready for submission or attorney review.

- Identify discrepancies, omissions, inconsistencies, and potential errors before they reach the next stage of the process.



Workflow & Compliance Audits

- Perform ongoing quality assurance reviews of specialized administrative workflows, including withdrawal-focused operations.

- Verify that required procedures, documentation, approvals, and compliance requirements are consistently followed.

- Identify process gaps and escalate issues that require attorney or management attention.

- Help maintain consistent quality standards across recurring workflows.



Case File & Data Auditing

- Conduct regular audits of digital case files, databases, and document management systems.

- Verify that records are complete, accurately categorized, properly documented, and organized.

- Identify missing or inconsistent information and coordinate corrections when necessary.

- Help ensure files remain organized and audit-ready.



Calendar & Deadline Verification

- Review department calendars and filing schedules for accuracy.

- Verify that court deadlines, discovery dates, follow-ups, and other critical dates are properly documented and tracked.

- Identify potential scheduling discrepancies or missing deadlines and promptly escalate concerns.



Case Information & Intake Review

- Review factual summaries, case notes, intake information, and supporting documentation for accuracy.

- Verify information before it is escalated to attorneys, clients, or external stakeholders.

- Ensure information is consistent across relevant systems and documents.



Qualifications & Requirements

- Minimum 1 year of experience in a legal environment.

- Experience with legal proofreading, quality assurance, compliance reviews, document auditing, or similar responsibilities.

- Associate's degree or equivalent professional administrative/legal experience.

- Strong understanding of legal procedures and administrative workflows.

- Experience reviewing or auditing withdrawal-focused workflows under strict compliance requirements is highly valued.

- Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify small errors, inconsistencies, and missing information.

- Highly organized with strong process-following and documentation skills.

- Excellent written English and proofreading abilities.

- Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent quality and productivity.

- Strong judgment when handling confidential and attorney-client privileged information.

- Comfortable working with digital case management systems, databases, document management platforms, and remote-work technology.

- Ability to consistently meet deadlines while maintaining a high standard of accuracy.



What Makes This Role Important

Quality control is more than proofreading—it is a critical part of protecting the integrity of our legal operations.

In this role, you will help ensure that the right information is in the right place, deadlines are accurately tracked, documents are complete, and processes are followed correctly.



Your work will provide attorneys and legal teams with greater confidence that the information they rely on has been carefully reviewed and verified.



Schedule

Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

Fully Remote





How to Apply

Please submit your resume highlighting your experience in legal quality control, compliance, proofreading, document review, case management, or administrative auditing.



Candidates with a strong track record of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail are encouraged to apply.

title: PERFORMANCE GRAPHIC DESIGNER — STATIC AD
description:
We are looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.





REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: UGC CREATIVE STRATEGIST (Scriptwriting and Creator Management)
description:
UGC CREATIVE STRATEGIST (Scriptwriting and Creator Management)

Full-Time | Remote | WRK Marketing

Starting Pay: $1,500/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week, Monday to Friday

Location: Remote



================

THE SHORT VERSION

================



You will be the UGC Creative Strategist for an Inc. 5000 performance marketing agency. You'll guide our clients' UGC programs, manage their Trybe accounts, write the scripts behind our ads, and brief and manage content creators to deliver creative that actually sells. 



If you understand why one hook gets a 3% CTR and another dies in two seconds, and you can get a creator to deliver exactly what the ad needs without ten rounds of revisions, keep reading.



If you are looking for a pure copywriting role or a social media posting job, this is not that job...



===================

ABOUT WRK MARKETING

===================



WRK Marketing is a performance marketing agency serving ecommerce and lead generation clients across the US. We build marketing systems, launch campaigns, improve funnels, manage paid traffic, produce creative, test offers, and grow revenue for our clients. We move fast. Priorities shift. Creative is the lever that moves results, and it has to keep up.



========================

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

========================



Your job is to keep a steady flow of high-performing ad creative moving from idea to live ad, across multiple client accounts.



In a typical week, you might:



- Write UGC and direct-response video scripts: hooks, problem/solution angles, testimonials, product demos, and offer-driven ads

- Write multiple hook variations for every concept so media buyers have real options to test

- Research a client's product, customer reviews, competitors, and ad libraries to find angles worth testing

- Source, vet, and onboard content creators for new client accounts

- Write clear creator briefs covering the script, shot list, tone, do's and don'ts, and deadlines

- Manage creator relationships day to day: timelines, revisions, usage rights, and deliverables

- Review raw footage and give sharp, specific feedback that gets usable content on the first pass

- Work with editors to turn footage into finished ads and variations

- Sit down with media buyers to review creative performance, figure out what's winning and why, and feed those learnings into the next round of scripts

- Keep the creative pipeline organized in ClickUp so nothing stalls and nobody has to ask for status



The mix changes based on client needs and launch schedules. Flexibility is part of the job description.



=====================

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

=====================



EXCELLENT COMMUNICATION

This is the most important requirement. You'll be writing scripts, briefing creators, giving feedback, and updating the team all day. You write clearly and concisely. You give feedback that is direct but keeps creators wanting to work with us. You can explain what's done, what's blocked, what needs a decision, and what happens next in four sentences. You ask sharp questions instead of guessing.



DIRECT-RESPONSE SCRIPTWRITING

You know the difference between content that looks nice and content that converts. You understand hooks, pacing, pain points, objection handling, social proof, and calls to action. You can write in a natural, spoken voice that sounds like a real person, not an ad.



CREATOR MANAGEMENT

You've worked with UGC creators or influencers before. You know how to find good ones, brief them well, manage timelines, and handle revisions without drama.



PERFORMANCE MINDSET

You're comfortable looking at hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, and ROAS, and using what you see to d
 what to make next. You don't need to run ads, but you need to understand how creative drives the numbers.



GENUINE OWNERSHIP

You follow up with creators who go quiet. You chase the deliverable that's two days late. You don't wait to be told what's next.



STRONG PLUSES

Agency experience. Experience writing for ecommerce brands on Meta and TikTok. Basic video editing skills. Experience managing multiple client accounts at once.



======================

TOOLS YOU MIGHT TOUCH

======================



ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets), Meta Ads Manager and Ad Library, TikTok Ads and Creative Center, Motion or similar creative analytics tools, CapCut, Canva, Figma, UGC and creator platforms, Shopify, and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Descript, and ElevenLabs.



Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, CapCut, and creator sourcing platforms is a major advantage.



==========================

SCHEDULE, PAY, AND BENEFITS

==========================



- Full-time remote, Monday through Friday

- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with a one-hour lunch (40 hours per week)

- $1,500/month



Please only apply if you can consistently work Eastern Time hours and the pay works for you.



==============

HOW TO APPLY

==============

Send all three of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

Your resume

1. Proof of work (required). We need to see both of the following:

-At least one direct-response ad scripts you wrote (Google Doc links are fine)

-At least one UGC or video ad you sourced, briefed, or managed (a live ad link, Drive link, or creator brief)

2. Performance results from creatives you worked on are a big plus. Design portfolios (static ads, graphics, branding) on their own will not be considered.

3. A personalized video introduction, 2 to 3 minutes. In your recording, please tell us:

-Why we should hire you

-Your experience writing ad scripts and managing content creators

-An ad you wrote or managed that performed well, and why you think it worked

-One script you wrote: walk us through the hook, the angle, and why you structured it that way

-How you work

-Why you are the right fit for this role

The recording does not need to be fancy. We just want to hear from you directly.  Applications missing any of the three required items will not be reviewed. We move quickly with strong candidates. If this sounds like you, apply now!

title: ad creative specialist
description:
Job Description – Static Ad Creative Specialist (Vitaronne)



Vitaronne is hiring! We are a fast-growing direct-to-consumer health & wellness brand serving customers across Canada, in both English and French. We're looking for a full-time Static Ad Creative Specialist who understands e-commerce funnels, paid social advertising and direct response marketing. You will create static image ads that drive traffic to our Funnelish funnels and convert, while matching our funnel pages and staying compliant with advertising and health regulations.



What does a Static Ad Creative Specialist do at Vitaronne?

You'll be responsible for creating static image ads for Meta 
 & Instagram) for our health and wellness products (supplements, personal care, oral care, pet health and more). Every ad sends traffic to a Funnelish funnel, so your creative must match the funnel's angle, offer and look. This involves product photo editing, AI-generated visuals and ad design. Marketing skills are required!



Responsibilities and Duties



Create new static image ads for our health & wellness products

Find and swipe proven winning static ads from competitors in the health & supplement space, then adapt them for our products. This is the most important part of the role (see below).

Apply direct response principles (strong headlines, hooks, problem/solution, testimonials, offers) to turn viewers into funnel visitors and customers

Make sure every ad matches the angle, offer and design of the Funnelish funnel it sends traffic to

Create and edit product photos and mockups that showcase features and benefits clearly

Produce each ad in English and French versions (copy will be provided or reviewed by the team; Québec French is a plus)

Make sure every ad accurately matches the product, packaging and claims in our funnels

Review ads for compliance with Meta advertising policies and Canadian health product rules (no misleading health claims, no prohibited before/after imagery, etc.)

Stay up to date with trends in health & wellness static advertising

Collaborate with the owner and our funnel builders



⚠️ Most important: swiping proven winners

The core of this role is spotting static ads that are already proven to work and turning them into Vitaronne creatives. We don't want guesses or "this looks nice." Every ad you swipe must come with proof that it's a winner, such as:



How long the ad has been running (e.g. 30+ days active in the Meta Ad Library)

Number of active variations or duplicates of the same ad

Visible engagement (likes, comments, shares)

Data from spy tools (e.g. Foreplay, Minea, AdSpy)



You will present each swipe with its stats before we adapt it.



Qualifications and Skills



Proven experience creating static ad creatives for e-commerce, ideally in health, beauty or supplements

Experience with AI image tools is a MUST (e.g. Midjourney, Higgsfield, ChatGPT/Claude)

Proficiency in Photoshop, Canva, Illustrator or similar

Experience using the Meta Ad Library and ad spy tools to find and validate winning ads

Strong understanding of direct response marketing and Meta Ads

Understanding of how funnels work (Funnelish experience is a big plus)

Familiarity with Meta's ad policies, especially for health-related products

Excellent communication skills in English; French is a strong bonus

Detail-oriented with a keen eye for visual design

Able to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment



Also:



You do what you say. You are passionate about delivering results and you always finish what you start. You take pride in keeping your word.



You have a high attention to detail. When it comes to details, nothing gets past you — and we mean nothing! So much so that we want you to include "the devil is in the details" as the answer to the first question when you submit your application. Seriously.



In your application, also include one example of a winning static ad you found, with the stats that prove it's a winner.



Preferably you have a couple of years of experience in this field and have worked for other e-commerce or dropshipping brands. You must understand how paid advertising works — how sending the right traffic to a funnel leads to conversions.



Salary Expectations

You will start as Trainee Static Ad Creative Specialist, working directly alongside the company owner, with a compensation of 300 /month



We always start with a one-month trial to ensure safety for both parties. After that, we'll have an evaluation to see if both parties would like to continue working together.



Benefits



Work in a young, ambitious health & wellness brand

Work fully remote

Get paid every two weeks instead of once per month (26 pay periods per year)

Grow your skills in the fastest-growing industry: digital marketing



If you can commit to and live with the following principles, you are the type of person who will be successful and help Vitaronne thrive. If you feel this level of engagement isn't right for you, we are not a good fit for you.



Our expectation is that you take the steps necessary to do what you say you will do and be accountable for your actions. In other words, live "Above the line."



Looking for a new adventure? Apply today!

title: Project Coordinator - Construction (Remote)
description:
🎯 Role Overview

The Project Coordinator owns the operational backbone of renovation projects from pre-kickoff through close-out. Where the Project Manager owns scope, budget, and the client relationship, you own the systems, documentation, schedule tracking, and vendor follow-through that keep every project moving.

This is an ownership role, not a task-taking role. You are expected to spot slippage before your PM does, chase answers without being reminded, and bring your PM a recommendation rather than a question. You will typically support two to four active projects at a time and maintain daily contact with contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to verify site activity, confirm schedule adherence, and document progress.



🧰 Key Responsibilities

**Project Systems & Documentation

- Own project folder structure, Slack channels, and document filing so that links, drive folders, and templates are correctly filed and accessible without prompting.

- Maintain project trackers and proposal decks as the single source of truth, updated from Matterport scans, floorplans, and vendor bids within 24 hours of new information.

- Build and update backyard overlays and other visual documentation using survey data, drone photos, and site imagery.

- Keep Buildertrend and all other project systems current. You are accountable for data integrity, not just data entry.



**Schedule & Site Accountability

- Maintain daily communication with contractors and subcontractors to confirm on-site presence and active work at assigned projects.

- Obtain photographic progress documentation no fewer than three (3) times per week, ensuring images are clear, time-stamped, and tied to specific milestones or ongoing construction activity.

- Compare actual site progress against the baseline schedule and flag variance early, before it becomes a client-visible delay.

- Escalate delays, missed updates, or contractor no-shows to the Project Manager within 24 hours, paired with a proposed recovery option.



**Vendor & Permitting Support

- Run bid requests end-to-end: issue, track, chase, and close out estimates and compliance documents (W9s, COIs, licenses).

- Prepare permit application packets to local requirements and submit to the appropriate portals or hand off to the permitting team as a complete package that requires no rework.

- Submit vendor payment requests using the designated SOP.

- Validate invoices and submit to Buildertrend.

- Maintain vendor records and flag lapsed insurance or licensing before it blocks work on site.



**Client & Stakeholder Communication

- Draft client recaps, kickoff materials, and bi-weekly updates by compiling inputs from the PM and vendor check-ins.

- Monitor project Slack channels and surface urgent messages or requests to the PM with the context needed to act.

- Schedule internal and client-facing meetings, including kickoff and proposal calls.



**Construction & Close-Out

- Own punch list tracking from creation through sign-off and confirm completion with photo evidence.

- Coordinate final photography, walkthrough scheduling, and close-out document packaging.

- Collect final invoices from all contractors and audit each contract to verify that all agreed-upon work has been completed.

- Support quality control from project initiation through close-out, ensuring all work meets established standards and specifications.



📈 What Success Looks Like

Day 30: Fully independent on project systems, trackers, and filing across all assigned projects.

Day 60: Running vendor follow-up and permit packet preparation without PM prompting, with zero missed photo documentation cycles.

Day 90: Your PM comes to you for project status rather than assembling it themselves. Punch lists and close-out packages are complete and audit-ready.



🧑‍💻 Skills & Qualifications

** Required

- 2+ years in project coordination, operations, or administrative support in a fast-moving environment.

- Demonstrated follow-through. You close loops without being chased.

- Strong written English: clear, professional, and concise.

- Advanced Google Workspace skills, particularly Sheets (filters, lookups, conditional formatting).

- Comfort managing three or more concurrent projects with competing deadlines.

- Availability during US business hours, with reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace for calls.



**Preferred

- Experience with Buildertrend, Slack, ClickUp, Asana, or comparable project management tooling.

- Background in construction, renovation, design, real estate, or property operations.

- Exposure to permitting, inspections, or municipal processes.



🚩 This Role Is Not a Fit If

- You need step-by-step direction to make progress.

- You go quiet when you hit a blocker instead of escalating it.

- You are looking for a purely administrative, ticket-taking role.

Nice to Have Skills

• Familiarity with e-commerce integrations, apps, and third-party tools. 

• Exposure to international e-commerce operations or cross-border selling. 

• Comfortable supporting or overseeing digital marketing initiatives in partnership with specialists or agencies.

title: Video Editor for Ecommerce - Facebook Ads
description:
Company Overview:



At ACTIV, we are a forward-thinking ecommerce marketing agency dedicated to revolutionizing how brands connect with their audiences. Our mission is to craft compelling marketing campaigns that not only captivate but also convert. Our brands are some of the fastest growing brands in the DTC space that are in the health and wellness space. With creativity at our core, we strive to push the boundaries of ecommerce marketing, making an indelible impact on the industry.



Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Video Editor to join our dynamic team for a full time role. This individual will play a crucial role in post-production video editing, creating engaging and effective video assets that resonate with our target audiences and drive purchases for ecommerce brands. The ideal candidate will have a blend of creative talent, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of ecommerce marketing.



Qualifications:

At least 2 years of experience in video editing within the ecommerce marketing space, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work.

Demonstrated proficiency in video editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and Davinci.

Solid understanding of key metrics like hook rate, hold rate, and click through rate, and expertise in creating short-form direct response videos.

A background in creative strategy is highly advantageous.

Agency experience is a plus

Experience using AI tools like Higgsfield, Claude, ChatGPT, and others

BONUS: If you can create your own videos based on the brand data (winners, angles, content that’s working) - we pay out bonuses for this type of work

Fluency in English is required.





Key Competencies:

Strong creative and direct response skills, with the ability to produce content that engages and converts.

Experience taking briefs from a creative strategist and developing high-quality video assets.

A desire to continually learn, grow, and challenge the status quo in video editing and content creation.

Ability to utilize AI tools in the editing process as well as learning new AI tools to expedite the ability to create more winning creative.

Ability to follow and capitalize on emerging trends, creating unique and compelling video content.

A strong desire to be creative and push the limits with new video concepts for our advertising campaigns.

You need to be a self-starter. You will be given the creative freedom to create winning assets and data from the brands you work on.





Overview:

As part of the ACTIV agency, you play a crucial role in shaping the visual storytelling and narrative of our ecommerce clients. Your expertise in video editing will be instrumental in creating compelling content that not only reflects the essence of each brand but also drives new customer acquisition at scale. Given the remote nature of your role, we value independence, communication, and the ability to manage time effectively across different time zones.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Video Editing: You will be responsible for editing raw footage into polished content for Meta & TikTok. This involves cutting hooks effectively, creating a cohesive story through the video content, and making the video engaging and effective to drive higher thumb stop rates (staying past the first 3 seconds), longer hold times (watching for at least 15 seconds), and high click through rates.



Collaboration: Regularly collaborate with the creative team, including directors, content creators, and other editors, to align on the creative vision and ensure that the final products meet or exceed client expectations. Communication will primarily be via digital platforms, including Slack, and once a week video calls via Slack.

Creative Input: Contribute ideas and suggestions to improve content quality during brainstorming sessions and creative meetings. Your input on the creative direction, storytelling elements, and visual style is highly valued.

Project Management: Manage your video editing projects from conception to delivery, ensuring that all content is completed within the agreed timelines and adheres to the client's brand guidelines. This includes prioritizing tasks, setting milestones, and keeping stakeholders informed of progress.

Quality Control: Ensure all videos meet ACTIV’s quality standards and are optimized for viewing on Meta & TikTok.

Technical Proficiency: Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of video editing software and technologies, suggesting upgrades or new tools as necessary to keep our content cutting-edge. ACTIV can and will provide you with additional software access when needed and necessary to do your job better.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Given your remote location and the flexible working hours, adaptability to the needs of the team and projects across time zones is essential. You must be willing to adjust your working hours when needed to meet critical deadlines or collaborate with the team.



Working Hours:

This position offers flexible working hours to accommodate the difference in time zones between Eastern Standard Time (New York, USA) and your time zone. We expect a reasonable overlap with the team's working hours for meetings and collaborative sessions but will work together to establish a schedule that suits everyone.



Expectations:

Maintain open and consistent communication with your team and direct report.

Deliver high-quality video content within specified deadlines.

Be proactive in addressing challenges or delays that may impact project timelines.



Tools and Software:

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, and other relevant video editing software is expected.



Compensation:

The Video Editor role is a dynamic position with the opportunity to significantly impact the success of our e-commerce clients through compelling video content. Recognizing the importance of this role, we offer competitive compensation packages for a full time role:

Compensation: 

Compensation is dependent on location of hire and competitive pay for the region the video editor is in. You will be asked your expected range of pay in your job application.

Note: Though output will be measured and managed, quality is essential. This is why we created a bonus structure that supports higher quality content that can scale spend behind it, versus creating a lot of content that may not scale spend behind it.



Expectations and Growth:

This role will be a full time role with expectations that we will provide you with the resources to succeed. This growth path is supported by a clear compensation and bonus structure that rewards high performance and the achievement of key milestones in ad spend supported by the content produced.We believe this structure will motivate our Video Editor to continuously strive for excellence, producing content that not only captivates audiences but also significantly contributes to the success of our e-commerce clients' campaigns.



To Apply:

To apply for this role, you will need to fill out this form: 
  that is 27 questions in total. You will then be asked to do a short project that displays your work with a loose brief and video resources provided showing your ability to take a brief and create a strong video creative from it. Once we review your video, we will set up an interview to the qualified candidates and then if you meet our standards then we would make a job offer.

title: Google Business Profile & Listings Specialist for US Church Marketing Agency (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We’re a US-based church marketing company looking for one sharp, detail-obsessed Listings Specialist to keep the Google and online listings for about 180 US churches accurate. This is a long-term, full-time role for someone who gets real satisfaction from getting small details exactly right.



You don’t need local SEO experience. We’ll train you on our process. You need to be organized and careful, and you need to ask when you’re not sure.



When a church’s Christmas Eve service time is wrong on Google, a family shows up to an empty parking lot and may not try again. Your job is to make sure that doesn’t happen at any church we serve.



The basics:



- Full-time and long-term. This is not a short project or a gig.

- Salary: $800 USD per month. Paid in USD, reviewed at 90 days.

- Schedule: flexible. We’ll set your hours together, and at least part of your shift will fall during Philippine daytime. This is not the full graveyard shift most US-hours roles demand. Once we agree on your hours, you’re reliably at your desk during them, every workday.

- 100% remote.



What you’ll own:

- Keeping each church’s Google Business Profile complete and correct: hours, service times, photos, categories, and holiday hours

- Setting up and claiming each church’s listings on 25+ sites, including Apple Maps, Bing, Yelp, and church directories, then logging every one in our tracker

- Checking that each church’s name, address, and phone number match exactly everywhere they appear online, and fixing the ones that don’t

- Scheduling Google posts for every church. AI writes the first draft. You check it against the facts and fix what it got wrong

- Posting replies to Google reviews from each church’s approved templates, and flagging any negative review to our US team the same day

- Sending short, templated
s to church offices to collect photos, verification codes, and holiday service times

- Running our Christmas and Easter updates across every church: holiday hours, event posts, and local community calendar submissions

- Keeping our tracking spreadsheet clean enough that monthly reports build themselves

- You will not make phone calls to clients. This is behind-the-scenes support.



Who we’re looking for:

- This is a faith-based role. You must be a born-again Christian who is passionate about helping churches reach more people and grow. We are especially looking for people who are active leaders in their own local church

- The kind of detail-oriented that notices a phone number formatted two different ways in the same spreadsheet, and can’t leave it alone until it’s fixed

- Organized enough to track 180 churches without letting one slip. You follow a checklist the same way every time, even on the 40th church of the day

- At least one year of admin, data entry, or virtual assistant work for a US business or agency. Google Business Profile or local SEO experience is a plus, not a requirement

- Strong Google Sheets skills. Sorting, filtering, and keeping a big tracker accurate should feel normal to you

- Excellent written English. Posts and review replies go out under a church’s name, and you’re the last check before they do. You catch it when AI invents a service time or a sentence sounds off

- You ask instead of guessing. When two sources disagree about a church’s address or service time, you check with us first

- Rock-solid reliability. You show up every day, on time, and you do not need to be managed



This job is NOT for you if:

- You want creative work all day. This role is mostly data and follow-through

- Doing the same task for dozens of churches in a row sounds boring to you

- You’d rather guess than ask a question

- You’re planning to keep freelance clients on the side. We’re hiring your full attention

- You’re not a believer, or you’d rather not spend every workday on church work. Our whole business is churches. There’s no version of this job that isn’t

- Your internet or power situation is shaky and you have no backup plan. Deadlines don’t wait for brownouts



If any of those describe you, no hard feelings. Save us both the time and skip this one.



About us REACHRIGHT is a US-based church marketing agency, 10 years old, with team members across the US and the Philippines. We already have 11 Filipino teammates. We are an openly Christian company, and everyone on our team shares one mission: helping churches reach more people. We serve pastors and churches every single day.



How to apply:

1. Start your application with the word “Aloha” so we know you actually read this posting.

2. Take the detail test below. List every difference you find between the church’s correct information and the listing we found online. Then tell us which mistake would hurt the church most if nobody fixed it, and why.

3. Tell us about a time you caught a mistake that everyone else missed.

4. Tell us how you are involved in your local church today.

5. Include a resume and a link to a short video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself.



"THE DETAIL TEST"



The church’s correct information:



Grace Harbor Church

1420 Oak Hollow Drive, Suite 200, Round Rock, TX 78664

(512)
Sunday services: 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM

The listing we found online:



Grace Harbour Church

1420 Oak Hollow Dr, Suite 200, Round Rock, TX 78646

(512)
Sunday services: 9:00 AM and 11:30 AM

Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test task before we make an offer.



Applications that do not start with “Aloha,” that skip the detail test, or that have no video will not be reviewed.

Also, share your portfolio/sample works.

title: Shopify Website & Instagram Social Media Manager
description:
Shopify Website & Instagram Social Media Manager



We are looking for an experienced and creative; Shopify Website & Social Media Manager to help us improve and grow our online fashion and accessories business.



Our company sells Jewelry, clothing, bags, and accessories, and we are looking for someone who can take responsibility for both our Shopify website and our Instagram presence.



The main goal is simple: create a professional and attractive online presence / shopify store that helps us sell more products.



Shopify Website Management: We are looking for someone who can improve and potentially redesign our existing Shopify website.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Improving the overall design and professional appearance of our Shopify store

- Making the website easier and more enjoyable for customers to use

- Improving the customer journey with a strong focus on conversions and sales

- Updating product pages and collections

- Adding and replacing product photos

- Checking and updating product information

- Making sure prices, descriptions, variants, links, images, and other product data are correct

- Keeping the website visually consistent and professional

- Making sure products featured on Instagram are correctly linked to the website

- Suggesting improvements that can help increase online sales



We are looking for someone who understands that a beautiful website is important, but **converting visitors into customers is the number-one priority.**



## Instagram & Social Media Management



You will also be responsible for managing our Instagram account on an ongoing basis for a fixed weekly fee of 500PHP. 



You must have experience working with Meta Business Suite and be comfortable planning and scheduling Instagram content in advance.



Weekly Content Planning



At the beginning of every week, we expect to receive a clear content plan showing:



- Which products will be promoted

- Which photos/content will be posted

- The planned posting schedule for the week

- How the different products and categories will be presented



Because we sell jewelry, clothing, bags, and accessories, the content will include different types of products. However, the complete Instagram feed should still look professional, consistent, stylish, and visually connected as one brand. We are upcoming so we will add more and more items on our website. 



### Posting Requirements



We expect:



- **1 Instagram post every day (7 days per week)**

- Posts planned and scheduled through Meta Business Suite

- Products correctly linked/tagged to our website 

- Professional captions with a commercial focus with #

- A consistent visual style across the Instagram feed

- Regular Instagram Stories throughout the week

- Attractive and professionally organized Instagram Highlights

- Content that does not only look beautiful but is designed to **generate interest, website traffic, and sales**\

- ALL content needs to be translated in Dutch!! 



## What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate:



- Has proven experience with Shopify

- Has experience redesigning and improving Shopify stores

- Has strong experience with Instagram management

- Has experience using Meta Business Suite

- Knows how to schedule Instagram content in advance

- Understands Instagram product/catalog integration

- Has a strong eye for fashion, jewelry, accessories, and visual branding

- Understands how to create a consistent and premium-looking Instagram feed

- Can edit photo's and can create good instagram post by just getting the article on photo with white background. 

- Is commercially minded and understands that **selling products is our main objective**

- Can work independently and proactively, with good communication

- Is accurate when updating product information and website data

- Can create and follow a structured weekly content plan

- Communicates clearly and reliably

- We are looking for someone who is hardworking, reliable, and honest.



## Long-Term Position



We are looking for someone for a **long-term collaboration**, not just a one-time project.



Initially, there will be more work involved because we want to improve/redesign the Shopify website and make sure all products and information are correct.



After this initial phase, we would like you to continue managing and updating the website when necessary while taking ongoing responsibility for our Instagram account.



The social media management will be based on an agreed **fixed weekly price**.



## When Applying



Please send us:



1. Examples of Shopify websites you have worked on

2. Examples of Instagram accounts you have managed

3. Your experience with Meta Business Suite

4. Your experience with fashion, jewelry, bags, accessories, or similar e-commerce brands

5. Your proposed **fixed weekly fee** for ongoing Instagram management

6. Your proposed price for the initial Shopify website improvement/redesign

7. A short explanation of how you would approach our Instagram strategy to increase product sales



Please only apply if you have relevant experience and can show examples of previous work. 



We are looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term part of our business and help us build a **professional, consistent, sales-focused online brand.**



Please be aware, there are two functions in this vacancy, first is updating the website, we will give you our login of our other store, you can copy the product photo's and see all the correct articles with ean codes. We will give you 2000PHP for rebranding our website and make it perfect with a new design, all the items needs to have description, needs to have a headphoto and a second photo and all needs to have the good price with the correct EAN. We expect that if we check the website again, that there will be a totally better / proffessional website where our customers can build on. The 2000PHP is one time payment;



The second item is that you will weekly be our social media manager, you will plan all the content (7 posts) and story's and add them in the high lights for 700 PHP each week.

title: Amazon Senior Account Manager | XP Strategy
description:
ABOUT US

XP Strategy runs Amazon and marketplace advertising for seven- and eight-figure sellers in the US and internationally. We handle PPC, creative, catalog, and marketplace expansion across Amazon, Walmart, Target, and TikTok. As an Amazon Ads Verified Partner, we work hands-on in AMC and DSP, and we run advertising in Walmart Connect and Target Plus. The team is small, senior, and fully distributed, and we are growing.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You run a portfolio of client brands end to end. You set each brand's strategy, you are the client's point of contact in both directions, and whether the targets get hit is on you. The job is as much about the relationship as the numbers: you set expectations early, raise problems before the client does, and keep your composure when things go sideways.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- FLUENT WRITTEN AND SPOKEN ENGLISH. Client communication is the core of this role, and it is the first thing we screen for. If that is not a strength, this position is not for you.

- 3+ years of client-facing experience at an Amazon or ecommerce agency, running several brands at once, including seven- and eight-figure sellers

- Strong command of Amazon PPC: campaign types, match types, ranking, branded vs non-branded, and audience advertising, enough to challenge a specialist's plan and explain the trade-off to a brand owner

- Hands-on Amazon account management: product health, listing optimization, competitor tracking, pricing, reviews, inventory, and launches

- Seller Central fluency: you can tell an ads problem from an account-health problem

- A track record of growing accounts, not just maintaining them

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. You can build a report, read it, and turn it into a recommendation

- Experience directing cross-functional teams without direct authority

- The composure to handle a hard conversation professionally: deliver bad news early and hold a realistic line

- Comfortable running several accounts at once without dropping details, with ClickUp, Asana, or a similar tool in daily use

- DSP, Walmart, or Target retail media experience is a plus, as is running quarterly business reviews



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Client relationship. Set concrete targets with each client (ACoS, TACoS, revenue, launch milestones) and revisit them as often as the account needs. Specialists execute; you steer.

- Onboarding. Run onboarding end to end: kickoff, access, expectations, and baselines inside the first 30 days.

- Quality control. Nothing reaches a client until you have checked it against the target it was meant to move.

- Internal direction. Set priorities for the PPC, creative, and catalog teams, and keep everyone clear on what matters for each account.

- Communication and retention. Keep a steady rhythm of written updates and report calls, framed in revenue and profitability rather than ad metrics alone. Come to every call with an agenda and next steps, watch for early warning signs, and handle unhappy clients directly.

- Growth. Spot the next opportunity for each brand and bring it as a worked-up proposal. Keep ClickUp current.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AFTER A YEAR

- Your clients are still your clients, and they would take a reference call for us.

- Specialists know what matters on each account without being asked twice, and nothing has gone to a client that embarrassed us.

- Your accounts have grown, whether through a new marketplace, more brands, or expanded scope.



WORKING TERMS

- Fully remote, on a distributed team

- US Eastern hours, 9:00am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday

- Paid time off

- Direct access to leadership, with influence over how accounts are run

- Exposure to seven- and eight-figure brands across Amazon, Walmart and Target

- Pay is commensurate with experience



HOW TO APPLY

Read this post fully, then complete our short application form. It includes a 2-minute video where you walk us through how you would handle a client who is unhappy with last month's results.



Form:

title: Architect / Residential Designer — Modern Lake Cabin (U.S. Residential Experience)
description:
I am looking for an experienced Architect or Residential Architectural Designer to help develop a custom approximately 1,000–1,100 sq-ft, single-story lake cabin in Alaska, USA.



I already have a strong design direction, extensive reference photographs and a detailed design brief. I am looking for someone who can take these ideas and develop a thoughtful, dimensionally accurate residential design — not simply trace an existing sketch into CAD.



The home is inspired by a small modern cabin with a long rectangular footprint, simple roof form, vaulted/open central living space, dramatic window wall and substantial covered outdoor living area.



The main window wall will face the lake, and maximizing the relationship between the house and lake is a major design priority.



The home will include 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, an open kitchen/dining/living great room, private primary suite, larger primary bathroom, walk-in closet, dedicated walk-in pantry, integrated workstation, laundry/mechanical space and covered lake-facing deck.



A particularly important design challenge is acoustic privacy. The primary suite should occupy the quieter portion of the house while maintaining excellent lake views and should be thoughtfully separated from the kitchen/living area, guest spaces, laundry/mechanical equipment and outdoor entertaining areas.



Who I’m Looking For



I am looking for someone with approximately 3+ years of professional residential architectural design/drafting experience; 5+ years preferred.



Strong candidates will have experience with:



* U.S. single-family residential design

* Small homes, cabins, ADUs or similarly efficient floor plans

* Residential space planning

* Wood-frame construction

* Floor plans, elevations and sections

* Construction-document preparation

* AutoCAD, Revit, Chief Architect or comparable professional software

* Designing from reference images and client requirements

* Cold-climate/snow-country homes is a plus

* 3D modeling/rendering is a plus



Licensed architects are welcome and encouraged to apply, but architectural licensure is not required if you have strong residential design experience and an excellent portfolio.



Initial Scope



This first phase will focus on design development, including:



* Dimensioned floor plan

* Interior and exterior dimensions

* Doors and windows

* Kitchen and pantry layout

* Bathroom layouts

* Closet/storage planning

* Laundry/mechanical location

* Furniture placement for scale

* Lake-facing workstation

* Covered-deck planning

* Basic exterior elevations

* Roof concept

* Approximately 2–3 revision rounds



Final Alaska structural engineering, snow-load calculations, foundation engineering and jurisdiction-specific permit requirements will be coordinated separately.



To Apply



Please begin your application with “LAKE CABIN” so I know you have read the complete posting.



Please include:



1. 2–3 examples of residential floor plans that you personally designed or developed.

2. One complete residential drawing set, if available.

3. Briefly explain exactly what you personally did on those projects.

4. How many years of residential design/drafting experience do you have?

5. Have you worked on U.S. residential projects? If yes, where?

6. Have you designed wood-framed homes?

7. Have you worked on cold-climate or high-snow-load homes?

8. What software do you use?

9. Are you comfortable making design recommendations and improving a client’s conceptual layout rather than simply drafting it?

10. What is your hourly rate or estimated fixed price for a project of this scope?

11. What would your estimated turnaround time be?



Please include floor plans and technical drawings in your portfolio, not only 3D renderings.

We sell jewelry, clothing, bags and accessories. We do not want just a few small changes — we want you to take responsibility for the complete website and give it a totally new, professional and sales-focused look.

Our main goal is simple: the website should look professional, build trust and make customers want to buy our products.

What needs to be done:

- Completely redesign our Shopify store

- Create a modern, professional and easy-to-use webshop

- Make sure the website looks great on both mobile and desktop

- Check and update all existing products

- Every product must have a clear and professional product description

- Check product names, prices, EAN codes, variants and other product information

- Use our existing 
 listings as the main reference for product information, EAN codes and photos

- Replace and correctly organize product photos in Shopify

- Make sure the entire website and all product information are fully up to date

Product Photo Editing is Important



You must also be able to edit product photos.

Especially for our jewelry, we want a clean and consistent appearance. Jewelry should be shown at approximately the same size and position in each product image, and gold and silver products should have consistent, realistic gold and silver colors.

The complete webshop should have one professional and consistent visual style.

Fashion & Jewelry Experience

We prefer someone who has an affinity with jewelry, fashion, clothing and accessories.

You should understand what customers are looking for and know how to present products in a way that makes them attractive to buy.

Sales and conversion are our number-one priority.



Payment – ₱2,000 Fixed Price

The total payment for this project is ₱2,000 PHP fixed price.

You are completely free to manage your own working hours. We do not require you to work at specific times. You can organize the project yourself and let us know when everything is finished.

However, we expect to see a significant improvement. The complete website, products, descriptions, photos and information should be properly finished and up to date.



₱1,000 First Sale Bonus

When the redesigned website generates its first sale, we will give you an additional ₱1,000 PHP bonus.

We believe that if your website redesign helps us achieve our first sale, your work should be rewarded for it.

Long-Term Opportunity

If we are happy with your work, this does not have to be a one-time project.

We would like to continue working with the right person on a long-term basis. After the initial redesign, we can agree on a monthly fixed fee for keeping the Shopify store up to date, updating products and photos, adding new products and continuously improving the website.

Please apply with examples of Shopify websites you have worked on and, if possible, examples of product/photo editing you have done.

We are looking for someone who is hardworking, honest, reliable, creative and able to work independently.



We expect to have the website rebuild in the end of october max.

title: Follow-Up & Client Records Coordinator - US Financial Advisory Firm
description:
Before anything else, please answer these two questions in your application. Start your application with the words "Nothing Slips" so we know you read this post.



Question 1: A prospect booked a meeting with us, didn't show up, and hasn't replied to one follow-up
. What do you do next, and how do you make sure it actually happens?



Question 2: One of our team members hasn't completed a follow-up task that's overdue by 3 days. How do you handle it? Write out the exact message you would send them.



Applications without both answers will not be reviewed.



THE HONEST VERSION OF THIS JOB



Part of this role is politely telling the owner of our firm that he hasn't done something he said he would do. Then following up again two days later if it still isn't done.



If that sounds stressful, this isn't the right role for you. If it sounds satisfying, keep reading.



ABOUT US



Klyman Financial is a US-based financial advisory and life insurance practice. We help families and business owners with investment management, retirement planning, and life insurance.



We are a small, busy team, and we are growing faster than our follow-up process can keep up with. Good prospects book meetings, don't show, say "let's reconnect next month," and then quietly disappear because nobody remembered. That is costing us real money, and it is the problem you would be hired to solve.



WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO ALL DAY



Make sure nobody is forgotten

- Every prospect and client has a status, a next action, an owner, and a follow-up date. No exceptions.

- When someone says "call me next month," that becomes a dated task immediately, not a note in somebody's memory.

- You produce a daily list of who needs to be contacted today, and by whom.



Chase our team until things are done

- Check that assigned follow-ups were actually completed, not just assigned.

- Send polite, specific reminders when they weren't. Follow up again when the reminder is ignored.

- Run a weekly review meeting where you report what is outstanding and confirm completion with each person.

- Notice patterns. If the same task type is always late, tell us why and help us fix it.



Clean up the backlog

- We have roughly 2,000 past leads from the last year sitting in our system, mostly unsorted.

- You will work through them with our leadership team: who is worth contacting, who goes into a nurture sequence, who should be closed out.

- Keep the records accurate and complete as you go.



Keep the system honest

- Track where each lead came from (ads, webinar, newsletter, referral) through to booked meetings and new clients.

- Maintain a simple interim tracker in Trello or similar while we finish setting up our new CRM.

- Keep confidential client information handled carefully and professionally.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must have:

- 2+ years in operations, client coordination, account management, executive assistance, appointment setting, or a similar role where following up with people was a core part of your day

- Experience working inside a CRM every day (any CRM: HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zoho, Salesforce, Follow Up Boss, Monday, or similar)

- Comfortable, polite persistence with people more senior than you, including business owners

- Excellent written English. You will be writing messages that clients and our team read.

- Very organized, with a high standard for accurate records and confidentiality

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work

- Able to overlap at least 4 hours per day with US Eastern Time business hours



Nice to have, but genuinely not required:

- Experience cleaning up a large, messy contact database

- Background in financial services, insurance, healthcare, legal, or another field where accurate records really matter

- Familiarity with Trello, Calendly, Zoom, or Zapier

- Experience building follow-up sequences or automations



Please note: this is not primarily a technical or automation role. If your main skill is building workflows and automations, this probably is not the right fit, and we would rather tell you that now than waste your time.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH YOUR TIME



You would be the person who owns this, not someone waiting to be told what to do. Our team is small enough that your work is visible immediately, and we are growing fast enough that this role will grow with us. We are looking for someone long term.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start with "Nothing Slips"

2. Your answers to the two questions at the top

3. Your resume

4. A short description of a time you had to follow up with someone repeatedly to get something done, and how it turned out

5. A 90-second video (Loom, Google Drive, or any link) telling us about that story in your own words. No screen share needed, we just want to hear how you talk.

6. Your monthly rate and the hours you can commit to

title: Amazon Operations Manager
description:
# Amazon Operations Manager to Own the Channel End to End - PPC, Profit and Growth for a Category-Leading Health Brand



We're a US Amazon brand selling health products - #1 in our category, with $5M+ a year in sales. Amazon is our main channel. Our team works remotely: a full-time creative designer, a freelance listing designer, a supply chain lead, an assistant, and an external PPC agency.



We're looking for an experienced Amazon Operations Manager to run our Amazon channel day to day and own its profit - PPC, pricing, listings, supply and weekly performance. You'll lead our creative designer and our supply chain lead, and report directly to our founder. Our PPC agency stays until the end of the year, then PPC comes in-house - and you run it. **This isn't an assistant or VA role** - you own the results. And you don't start from zero: our scorecard, playbooks, inventory forecasting, pricing tests and AI agents are already built. Your job is to run them well and make them better.



## 💼 What You'll Do



**Channel Performance**



- Own Amazon revenue, net margin and market share

- Run our weekly scorecard and the playbooks it triggers

- Deliver a clear weekly update to the founder with insights and next steps



**Profit**



- Grow net margin through every lever - PPC, product costs, returns, fees and pricing



**PPC**



- Run a $50K+/month PPC budget hands-on from January - campaign structure, bids, keywords, negatives, budgets

- Work with our PPC agency until then, and lead the handover



**Pricing**



- Run structured price tests with our pricing system

- Read the results and d
 the next move



**Listings & Creative**



- Direct our creative designer on main images, listing tests, video, titles and bullets

- Judge creative by results - CTR and conversion



**Supply & Team**



- Lead our supply chain lead and creative designer

- Plan stock and reorders weekly so ads and pricing match what's on hand



## 🧠 What You Bring



- You've personally managed $50K+ a month in Amazon PPC spend in one account, hands-on

- 4-6 years hands-on Amazon experience - brand or agency side - with results you can show

- You've managed at least one person day to day

- You've managed FBA stock and restock decisions with a supply person

- You like working with clear systems and playbooks - and you improve them

title: Personal Assistant – LinkedIn & Personal Brand Specialist
description:
## Executive Assistant – LinkedIn & Personal Brand Specialist



We are looking for a **proactive, forward-thinking Executive Assistant with strong LinkedIn and personal branding experience** to support a growing business owner.



This is not a role for someone who simply waits for instructions. We are looking for someone who can **think ahead, identify opportunities, take ownership and bring ideas to the table.**



### Working Hours



- **3–4 hours per day**

- Ideally between **10:00 AM–2:00 PM BST**



### What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



- Highly proactive and forward-thinking

- Confident working independently

- **Experienced in LinkedIn management and personal branding**

- Strong in LinkedIn content strategy and engagement

- Excellent at research and identifying opportunities

- A strong communicator with good written English

- Organised and able to manage multiple priorities

- Comfortable supporting both **professional and personal/lifestyle tasks**

- Creative and able to come up with content and growth ideas

- Someone who takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do



### Main Focus: LinkedIn & Personal Brand



The main goal of this role is to help **grow and strengthen the business owner's personal LinkedIn presence**, while also supporting the company's business LinkedIn account.



The successful candidate will help:



- Grow the personal LinkedIn profile and increase relevant connections

- Increase engagement and visibility

- Identify potential clients, families, companies and family offices

- Research relevant people and organisations to connect with

- Identify networking, collaboration and speaking opportunities

- Look for opportunities for greater marketing exposure

- Engage strategically with relevant LinkedIn posts and conversations

- Develop strong content ideas based on current trends and relevant industry topics

- Help position the business owner as a knowledgeable and trusted professional in her field

- Support the growth of the business LinkedIn account alongside the personal profile



### Content & Engagement



You will be responsible for helping develop a **consistent and strategic LinkedIn presence**, including:



- Creating and suggesting content ideas

- Planning posts and maintaining a content calendar

- Recommending an appropriate posting frequency

- Writing or assisting with LinkedIn posts

- Regularly liking, commenting and engaging with relevant content

- Building meaningful and relevant connections

- Researching potential opportunities and people to connect with

- Monitoring LinkedIn conversations, trends and relevant industry topics



We are not simply looking for someone to post content. **We want someone who understands how to use LinkedIn strategically to build a personal brand, increase visibility and create genuine business opportunities.**



### Proactive & Forward-Thinking Support



You should be someone who naturally asks:



**“What can we do next?”**



We want a PA who can:



- Spot opportunities before being asked

- Bring fresh ideas and recommendations

- Research potential leads and connections

- Identify people the business owner should be speaking to

- Suggest ways to improve visibility and engagement

- Think strategically about LinkedIn growth

- Help create better systems and workflows

- Take ownership of tasks from start to finish



### Other EA / PA Support



Alongside LinkedIn and personal branding, you may also assist with general **EA/PA and personal/lifestyle tasks** as needed.



### IMPORTANT – APPLICATION REQUIREMENT



**Please do not apply if you do not have strong, hands-on LinkedIn experience.**



As part of the application process, shortlisted candidates will be asked to prepare a **short trial/sample 30-day LinkedIn strategy**.



We would like you to show us how you would approach growing:



1. **The business owner's personal LinkedIn profile**

2. **The company's LinkedIn business account**



Your sample should include your ideas for:



- Content strategy

- Content topics/ideas

- Suggested posting frequency

- Engagement strategy

- Connection-building strategy

- How you would increase visibility

- How you would identify relevant opportunities

- Goals/KPIs you would aim for during the first 30 days



**The key question we want you to answer is:**



> *“What would you do in your first 30 days to grow the business owner's LinkedIn presence, increase her visibility and identify new opportunities?”*



We are looking for **your own ideas and strategy**, so please make the proposal specific rather than submitting a generic LinkedIn plan.



### To Apply



Please send:



- Your updated CV

- A short introduction about yourself

- Examples of LinkedIn accounts or personal brands you have managed, if available

- A brief explanation of your LinkedIn experience

- Your **sample 30-day LinkedIn strategy/content calendar**



We are looking for someone who wants to become a **trusted right hand to the business owner**, not simply someone who completes a list of tasks.



If you are proactive, strategic, organised and genuinely good at LinkedIn, we would love to hear from you.

title: Remote Marketing & CRM Operations
description:

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.
