title: Freelance Senior Web Designer – UI/UX & Digital Experience
description:
Freelance Senior Web Designer – UI/UX & Digital Experience



Location: Philippines – Remote



Engagement: Freelance/project-based initially, with the opportunity for ongoing ad-hoc work



Hours: Flexible, with availability to collaborate with the UK team



Rate: ₱700.00 - ₱900.00 per hour, based on experience and portfolio



About the Role



Trojan, part of Buy It Direct, is looking for a Senior Web Designer with strong UI/UX and digital design experience to take ownership of the overall design direction, content presentation and user experience of our Trojan Commerce website.



This is not simply a WordPress implementation role. We are looking for someone who can step back and assess the website as a whole — understand what our business does, who our target audience is, what we are trying to communicate and what we want visitors to do.



You should be comfortable acting as a senior design adviser, not simply implementing instructions. We want someone who can independently identify issues and opportunities across the site's structure, messaging, navigation, hierarchy, imagery and overall user journey, and recommend clear, commercially sensible improvements.



This includes the words as well as the design. You should be able to review headlines, page copy, tone of voice and calls to action and advise when content is unclear, too long, poorly structured or not appropriate for the target audience. We do not expect you to be a specialist copywriter, but we do expect you to have the confidence to suggest better wording, restructure content and challenge what is already there.



The successful person should be able to take a business objective or a rough brief and turn it into a considered digital experience — advising us what the site should say, how it should say it and how it should look, rather than waiting for detailed design and content instructions from us.



What You'll Do



- Design Strategy & Creative Direction

- Take ownership of the overall visual direction and user experience of the website.

- Understand the business, its services, target audience and commercial objectives before making design recommendations.

- Review existing website pages critically and identify opportunities to improve their effectiveness.

- Advise on page structure, content hierarchy, navigation, messaging, imagery and calls to action.

- Challenge existing layouts where necessary and explain the reasoning behind your recommendations.

- Balance strong visual design with usability, accessibility and commercial effectiveness.



UI/UX & Website Design



- Design and improve modern, professional B2B website experiences.

- Develop clear information architecture, page structures and user journeys.

- Improve visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, layout, imagery and content presentation.

- Create responsive designs that work effectively across desktop, tablet and mobile.

- Consider how users scan, navigate and interact with commercial websites.

- Ensure consistency across pages, components and the wider website experience.

- Create wireframes, page concepts, mock-ups and high-fidelity designs where appropriate.

- Use design tools to communicate and develop design concepts.



WordPress Implementation



- Implement agreed design improvements within WordPress.

- Work confidently with Elementor or a similar WordPress page builder.

- Translate design concepts into polished, responsive live pages.

- Work within the existing website structure where appropriate rather than redesigning unnecessarily.

- Identify technical or usability limitations that may affect the proposed design and suggest practical alternatives.

- Maintain consistency across the website as new pages and improvements are introduced.



Ongoing Design Ownership



- Review the website proactively rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

- Identify areas that feel unfinished, inconsistent, unclear or visually weak.

- Recommend improvements based on design principles, user experience and business objectives.

- Take responsibility for the quality of your work from initial recommendation through to implementation.

- Work independently and manage priorities without requiring constant direction.

- Clearly explain your design decisions to stakeholders and respond constructively to feedback.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for a Senior-level web/digital designer, ideally with experience working in an agency or client-facing environment.



You should have:



- Strong experience in web design, UI/UX and digital experience design.

- A strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, layout and information architecture.

- The ability to think strategically about a website rather than simply improve its appearance.

- Experience designing websites around business objectives and user needs.

- Strong understanding of responsive web design and mobile-first principles.

- Experience with professional design tool.

- Strong WordPress experience, ideally with Elementor or a similar page builder.

- The ability to independently assess an existing website and recommend improvements.

- Experience with modern corporate, B2B or commercial websites.

- A strong understanding of navigation, user journeys and calls to action.

- The ability to turn recommendations into practical, high-quality designs and live website improvements.

- Excellent attention to detail and a strong visual/design judgement.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- The confidence to present and explain your design decisions to stakeholders.

- The ability to work independently without requiring step-by-step instructions.



Desirable



- Experience working on modern corporate and B2B websites

- E-commerce or conversion-focused website experience.

- Experience with WordPress page builders such as Elementor, Gutenberg or similar

- Experience with design systems

- Experience with branding or visual identity.

- Understanding of SEO, accessibility and web performance considerations.

title: Amazon Senior PPC Specialist | XP Strategy
description:
ABOUT US

XP Strategy runs Amazon and marketplace advertising for seven- and eight-figure sellers in the US and internationally, including UK-based Nature's Blends. We handle PPC, creative, catalog, and marketplace expansion across Amazon, Walmart, Target, and TikTok. As an Amazon Ads Verified Partner, we work hands-on in AMC and DSP, and we run advertising in Walmart Connect and Target Plus. The team is small, senior, and fully distributed, and we are growing.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You run the advertising for a portfolio of client brands. You hit each account's ACoS and TACoS targets. The Account Manager sets the goal; you d
 how the ads get there, from structure and bids to budgets, keywords, and negatives. You watch pacing daily and catch spend problems before they cost budget.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- EXPERIENCE WITH AMC IS REQUIRED. DSP experience is a strong plus.

- 3+ years managing Amazon PPC hands-on, ideally at an agency, across several brands at once

- A track record managing five-figure monthly ad spend for seven-figure brands (required)

- Deep command of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display

- Campaign architecture that holds up as an account scales: branded, non-branded, and competitor segmentation with deliberate match types

- Bid and budget discipline against clear ACoS and TACoS targets

- Bulk operations experience

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, with strong analytical skills

- At home in the Amazon Ads console and in AdLabs (our primary tool), Helium 10, Data Dive, and MixShift, with the judgment to override a tool when the data says otherwise

- Fluent written and spoken English; you can tell an Account Manager or brand owner why ACoS moved and what you are doing about it

- Comfortable running several accounts at once without dropping details, with ClickUp, Asana, or a similar tool in daily use

- Vendor Central, Walmart Connect, and Target retail media are a plus



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Campaign build-out. Build campaigns across ad types and match types, structured to our naming conventions and SOPs.

- Bids and budgets. Manage bids and budgets to each account's targets. Keyword harvesting and negations run on a set schedule, and budgets are planned around launches, Prime Day, and Q4 before the traffic arrives.

- Optimization and research. Tune placements and budgets continuously, run keyword, competitor, and market research, and A/B test content for conversion.

- Quality control. Check the accuracy of everything that ships to an account. A misplaced decimal on a bulk upload spends client money.

- Reporting and forecasting. Deliver reporting an Account Manager can put in front of a client, framed in revenue, profitability, and TACoS. Flag performance problems early, and build advertising forecasts clients can plan budget and inventory against.

- Collaboration. Work with Account Managers, creative, and catalog. When ranking or conversion is the actual problem, say so.

- Growth. Track Amazon advertising updates and bring the expansion opportunities you find in the data as concrete recommendations. Keep ClickUp current.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AFTER A YEAR

- Your accounts hold their ACoS and TACoS targets month over month.

- Account Managers trust your numbers without re-checking them, and your analysis shows up in their client calls.

title: Senior Graphic Designer

This is a key leadership role within our design workflow. You will set visual standards, maintain brand consistency, lead design reviews, and produce high-impact assets for our clients.





AUTONOMY AND WORK CULTURE

We believe in professional autonomy and do not use invasive screen monitoring or surveillance software. Our culture is built on trust, clear output metrics, and outcome-based accountability. We care about design quality, proactive problem-solving, and meeting project milestones. In return, we expect clear communication, accountability for deadlines, and timely responses during your shift.

Tool Fluency: Execute advanced design work primarily in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, while remaining comfortable utilizing Canva for fast asset iteration, collaborative templates, or client-facing handoffs.

- Proven professional experience as a Senior Graphic Designer or Creative Lead.

title: Prepress Graphic Designer - Custom Packaging
description:
Company: Hero Packaging (based in Sydney, Australia)



About Hero Packaging:



Hero Packaging is an Australian sustainable packaging company. We supply thousands of businesses with custom-printed packaging, and every custom order passes through our prepress team before it goes to print.



About the role:



You'll join our existing prepress designer to turn customers' artwork into accurate, print-ready files. This is a technical production role rather than a creative one. The work is about precision: getting sizes, colours, and layouts exactly right, every time. A mistake that gets past prepress ends up printed on thousands of units, so we're looking for someone who checks their work carefully.



What you'll do:



- Set up print-ready files on our product templates and dielines, to the correct size, bleed, safe area, and colour specifications

- Adjust customers' supplied artwork so it is printable: resizing, repositioning, fixing resolution, converting colours, outlining fonts, and recreating low-quality logos as vectors

- Create clear PDF approvals (proofs) showing the customer exactly how their packaging will print

- Apply customer revisions quickly and accurately, and keep track of versions

- Check every file against the order details before it is sent for approval or to print

- Flag artwork problems early, such as low resolution, colours that won't print as expected, or text too close to the edge

- Keep files organised and named consistently so anyone on the team can pick up a job



What we're looking for:



- At least 2 years' experience in prepress, print production, or packaging artwork

- Advanced Adobe Illustrator skills, plus confidence in Photoshop and Acrobat

- A solid understanding of print fundamentals: CMYK and Pantone colours, bleed, dielines, vector and raster artwork, resolution, and overprint

- Very high attention to detail, with a habit of double-checking your own work

- Clear written English, and the confidence to ask when a brief is unclear

- The ability to work through a steady queue of jobs and meet daily turnaround times

- A reliable computer, a stable internet connection, and a backup plan for outages



Nice to have:



- Experience with packaging such as mailers, boxes, labels, or flexible packaging

- Experience preparing files for flexographic or gravure printing

- Experience working remotely with an Australian or other international team



What we offer:



AUD $6–$9 per hour, based on experience, with stable full-time hours

A long-term role with a growing Australian brand

Daytime hours, since Sydney is only 2–3 hours ahead of the Philippines

Training on our products, templates, and processes from our current prepress designer



How to apply:



Send us:

- Your CV

- A portfolio or samples of prepress or print production work, with before-and-after examples if you have them

- A short note on your prepress experience and the software you use daily

We pay $150–$250 USD per video, depending on the length and complexity of the edit. You're paid per video — the more you deliver, the more you earn. Because we have consistent client work, the volume is steady and dependable.



How to Apply:

To show us you've actually read this listing, please include the word "EDIT" at the start of your reply. Applications without it won't be considered.



Next Steps:

Applicants who make it through to the next stage will be asked to complete a short editing test so we can see how you work. We know your time is valuable — anyone we hire will be reimbursed for the time spent on the test.

We're excited to find the right person to join the team long-term. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Turn Warm Crypto Intros Into Recurring Income - No Closing Required
description:
We're a multi-chain DeFi protocol building LP Bonds, a new liquidity primitive that locks liquidity long-term while keeping user positions tradable. We need Business Development partners who can introduce us to crypto launchpads, DEXs, chains, and established crypto projects.



We're live on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, ApeChain, BSC, Abstract, and Monad, with integrations running on Camelot DEX, HELLO DEX, and PancakeSwap. See it yourself: 



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬



Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.



𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡



Base Pay: $10/hour, 10 hours/week ($100/week). Paid 50% in Ethereum (ETH) and 50% in $GMI tokens on an 18-month vesting schedule, building you a long-term position in the multi-chain $GMI ecosystem.



Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay. All appointments and outreach are logged in our tracker; unlogged work doesn't count or pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: 20% of ALL upgrade fees generated by each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.



Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. No ceiling.



Commission is paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



Together with our referral program, we give nearly all of our upgrade revenue back to the people who grow the protocol. Every partnership you land gets its own fresh 180-day earning window.



𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘 𝗜𝗡 𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗟 𝗠𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗬 (𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽):



Mints $50,000 in bonds: $1,500 launch bonus paid as it happens, plus 20% of every upgrade fee as they roll in

Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



That's ONE introduction. Land three and run the math.



Note: A successful partnership means a project you introduced signs the LP Bonds integration agreement and goes live on our marketplace. You book the qualified call, I run the deal and close it.



𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗛𝗔𝗩𝗘:



Existing connections in crypto (launchpads, DEXs, chains, established projects)

/

Understanding of DeFi/crypto space

Hunger to earn based on results, not hours

To close deals (I handle that)

Any upfront investment

Previous BD experience (connections matter more)

Ready to turn your crypto connections into serious income?

 handle

title: Crypto BD Team Lead: $1,500-2,500/mo Base Pace + Uncapped Deal Bonuses (Remote)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
HOW TO APPLY

If this opportunity feels like the perfect fit for you and you meet the job qualifications, we invite you to learn more about our HiEnd Accents team in the Philippines and submit your application here: airtable(dot)com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagHKo8CnRtRpX585/form (NOTE: Replace the word "dot" with an actual dot)



Please note: Only applications submitted via this link will be considered.



Job Description



We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and creative Social Media Manager to join our team! As our Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for implementing our Social Media strategy in order to increase our online presence and strengthen our relationship with our customers and fans. You will be working closely with our Senior Social Media Manager and the remainder of our Marketing department. The platforms that you’ll primarily work on and be responsible for are (1) Instagram, (2)
, and (3) Pinterest. As our Social Media Manager, you will have a meaningful impact on our growth, bottom line, and brand identity in an exciting, design-driven company where being creative is just as important as being analytical.

, Instagram feed, Instagram Stories, and Pinterest, either within the app or by using tools such as Sprout Social or Later

Affiliate Marketing & Community Management

Asset Collection

title: Technical SEO Developer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them.



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

 • Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

 • Crawlability and indexation

 • Site architecture and internal linking

 • Canonicalization and rendering issues

 • Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

 • Work directly within:

 • WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

 • Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

 • PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

 • Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

 • Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

 • Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

 • Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone



Required Skills & Experience

 • 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

 • Comfortable editing live websites and templates

 • Working knowledge of:

 • HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

 • PHP and Shopify Liquid

 • Experience working directly inside:

 • WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

 • Strong understanding of:

 • Google Search Console

 • Ahrefs / Semrush

 • Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

 • Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

 • Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

 • Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

 • Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

 • Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements

description:

We're looking for one strong builder to turn detailed specs into working products, using AI coding tools to move fast without cutting corners.



You'll work directly with the founder, who is based in Bali on the same timezone as the Philippines.



What you'll build



A custom app for HighLevel (GoHighLevel), the CRM our contractors use.

Built with OAuth, custom pages, custom workflow triggers and actions, custom objects and webhooks.

It connects contractors' CRM accounts to our own platform.

It adds a branded inspection report generator, an estimator and proposal builder, and job costing.

A HighLevel template that sets up contractor accounts: pipelines, custom fields, forms, calendars, workflows and message templates.

Our core web platform. A property and job record system with:

a mobile-first, offline-capable field app for technicians (photos, readings, checklists)

warranty registration and a review queue

dealer ordering and a certification portal

an internal admin dashboard

Lead-generation tools. An instant roof and basement estimator widget, data-driven property lists, and integrations with mapping and property-data APIs.



Detailed specs are already written. Your job is to build them well, ask good questions, and tell us when something in a spec won't work.



Our stack



TypeScript, React, Node.js

tRPC, Drizzle ORM, MySQL or Postgres

HighLevel API and Marketplace modules

REST APIs and webhooks

Cloudflare, Vercel or similar hosting

AI coding tools daily: Claude Code, Cursor or similar



You must have



3+ years building and shipping full-stack web apps in TypeScript and React, with live projects you can show us.

Daily, serious use of AI coding tools. You know how to direct them, review their output, catch their mistakes, and keep a codebase clean when AI writes most of the first draft.

Experience integrating third-party APIs: OAuth, webhooks, and working from documentation you've never seen before. HighLevel experience isn't required; we'll expect you to learn its developer platform quickly with the help of AI tools.

Solid backend fundamentals: auth and permissions, database design, API security, and never trusting client input.

Comfort with ownership. You test your own work, write clear updates, and finish things.

Good written English. Most of our communication is async and written.



Nice to have



HighLevel (GoHighLevel) experience: snapshots, workflows, the API, or a Marketplace app

Offline-first mobile web apps (PWA, background sync)

Maps and geospatial work (Mapbox or Google Maps, parcel or building-footprint data)

PDF report generation

Stripe or payment integrations

Experience with construction, field-service or contractor software



How we work



Full time, async-first, with a short daily check-in during PH business hours.

Paid tools: AI coding subscriptions and hosting accounts are covered.

Real responsibility from week one. You won't be maintaining someone else's ticket queue.

Everything you build is owned by the company, and you'll sign an NDA and IP assignment.



How to apply



Send a message with:



Links to 2–3 things you've built, and your role in each.

A time you had to learn an unfamiliar API or platform quickly. How long did it take to ship something working, and how did you use AI tools to get there?

A short description of how you use AI coding tools day to day, and one time an AI tool gave you wrong code and how you caught it.

An intro video (2-3 minutes) introducing yourself. Walk us through your background and the projects you have built, then share a link (Loom, Google Drive, YouTube, etc.). Make sure the link is viewable without a password or sign-in.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Start your message with the word "PERMANENCE" so we know you read the whole post.

Step 2: Team and Mission

You will work directly alongside our Founder at Prime Home Cleaning Ltd. You will join a mission to alleviate the severe pressures of modern life for dual-income households. Your daily impact will be measured in relationship harmony restored, cognitive decompression delivered, and weekends successfully handed back to our clients.

Step 3: Culture and Work Ethos

We operate with absolute integrity and zero hidden agendas. We protect our clients' sanctuaries with uncompromising vetting and relentless operational precision. We treat every single clean as a critical mission to restore peace of mind.

Step 4: Candidate Challenge

Do not apply if you are a mercenary simply looking to clock in and collect a paycheck. We are hunting for a true Patriot who is fiercely protective of our 5.0-star reputation and obsessed with flawless execution. Continue reading only if inside you are screaming, "HELL YEAH!"

Step 5: Role Description

a. ROLE TITLE: Operations & Client Success Manager

b. Role Summary:

You will be the operational engine and the absolute frontline of our brand. You will seamlessly merge inbound sales, empathetic customer service, and daily scheduling to ensure our "Safe Hands" promise is never compromised.

c. Mission Alignment:

You propel our mission by converting overwhelmed, skeptical prospects into relieved clients, and by ensuring our housekeeping fleet runs with pinpoint, reliable precision across West Yorkshire.

d. Role Highlights:

• Acting as the empathetic, zero-judgement voice of the business when managing client enquiries and acute "mess shame" anxieties.

• Managing the daily support and operational deployment of our strictly vetted primary housekeepers.

• Building bulletproof back-office systems that scale effortlessly with our rapid, intent-driven growth.

Step 6: Candidate Attributes

• Extreme Accountability: You own outcomes entirely. If a schedule breaks or a client is unhappy, you fix it before placing blame.

• Deep Empathy: You listen to the invisible "mental load" our clients carry and respond with total validation and zero judgement.

• Operational Precision: You treat the CRM and scheduling boards as sacred. You do not let small details slip through the cracks.

title: UGC Manager (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
We are an 8-figure DTC e-commerce brand running performance-driven advertising campaigns across Meta 
 & Instagram), and we’re looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive UGC Manager to help us scale our creator content operation.



You’ll take ownership of our UGC pipeline — from finding and sourcing creators to managing communication, briefs, deadlines, follow-ups, and final content delivery.



Our primary markets are the United Kingdom and the United States, with additional markets potentially added as we scale.



## What You’ll Do



You’ll own the day-to-day UGC pipeline and make sure creators, briefs, creative strategists, and editors are all moving together.



### Creator Sourcing



* Source UGC creators in the United Kingdom and United States.

* Research and identify creators who fit our target audience, creative requirements, and campaign briefs.

* Build and maintain an organized database of potential creators.

* Vet creators based on content quality, communication, reliability, and suitability for our campaigns.

* Present the strongest creator candidates to our team for approval.

* Continuously build our creator network so we always have new talent available.



### Creator Management



* Handle creator outreach and initial communication.

* Coordinate pricing, deliverables, timelines, and requirements within our guidelines.

* Send creators clear briefs and creative instructions.

* Answer creator questions and make sure they understand exactly what needs to be delivered.

* Track every creator, brief, deadline, and deliverable.

* Follow up consistently before and after deadlines.

* Chase late creators and make sure projects don't get stuck.

* Coordinate revisions when content doesn't meet the brief.

* Make sure final content is delivered correctly and organized for our editing team.



### Internal Team Coordination



* Keep our creative strategists updated on creator progress.

* Coordinate with editors when new footage comes in.

* Maintain a clear overview of which creators are being sourced, contacted, confirmed, filming, overdue, delivered, or requiring revisions.

* Flag problems early rather than allowing deadlines to slip.

* Make sure the creative team always knows what content is coming and when.

* Keep our UGC pipeline organized and up to date.



## What We’re Looking For



We need someone who can take ownership and get things done without constant supervision.



You should be:



* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Proactive and resourceful.

* A strong communicator.

* Comfortable following up and chasing deadlines.

* Comfortable managing multiple creators and campaigns simultaneously.

* Able to work quickly in a high-volume environment.

* Good at prioritizing tasks.

* Reliable and consistent.

* Comfortable working independently.

* Comfortable using spreadsheets, project-management tools, messaging platforms, and creator databases.

* Able to keep accurate records and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



## Required Experience



* Previous experience managing UGC creators, influencers, talent, or creator campaigns.

* Experience communicating directly with creators.

* Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

* Ability to manage multiple creators and projects simultaneously.



### Nice to Have



* Experience working with DTC/e-commerce brands.

* Experience with Meta advertising or direct-response marketing.

* Experience sourcing creators in the UK or US.

* Familiarity with UGC platforms or creator marketplaces.

* Experience working with remote creative teams.

* Understanding of what makes UGC effective for paid social advertising.



## What Success Looks Like



Your job is to make sure our creative team always has a healthy pipeline of quality creator content.



You’ll be successful if you:



* Consistently source relevant, high-quality creators.

* Keep creators accountable to deadlines.

* Minimize late or missing deliverables.

* Keep our creator database and project tracking completely organized.

* Identify and solve problems before they become serious.

* Keep strategists and editors informed.

* Increase the volume of usable UGC we can produce.

* Make the entire creator process run smoothly without constant management from our side.



You’ll be measured primarily on creator throughput, quality of sourced creators, turnaround times, reliability, communication, and organization.



## Working Hours



6 hours per day, part-time.



This is an ongoing role for someone who can consistently dedicate approximately 6 hours every working day to the position.



Because our creators and team are located across different time zones, some flexibility with working hours is important.



## Compensation



$400 USD/month



This is a long-term opportunity with consistent work. As our creator operation grows, there is potential to take on additional responsibility.



## What We Offer



* Consistent, ongoing work with a fast-growing eight-figure DTC brand.

* Clear systems, briefs, and creative direction.

* A dedicated team of creative strategists and editors.

* An opportunity to take ownership of our creator operation.

* The chance to work directly on performance-driven advertising campaigns.

* A fast-moving environment where your work directly impacts our creative output and growth.



## How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous experience managing UGC creators, influencers, or creator campaigns.

3. Examples of UGC or creator campaigns you’ve managed, if available.

4. Which markets you’ve previously sourced creators in.

5. Your current time zone and availability.

6. The tools/platforms you’ve used for creator sourcing and management.



We’re looking for someone who is organized, proactive, accountable, and comfortable taking full ownership of the creator pipeline.



If you know how to find good creators, communicate clearly, chase deadlines, and make sure content actually gets delivered, we’d love to hear from you.

title: YouTube Channel Optimiser / YouTube SEO Specialist
description:
Applications close: Monday 24th August 2026 at 9am GMT



Overview

Heads Up is a UK consultancy helping school leaders move their schools from good to great and create excellent schools. We work with Primary, Secondary and Special School headteachers and senior leaders across three areas:

- having difficult conversations with staff

- moving a good school to great

- continuing excellence for heads already leading great schools.



We have an existing YouTube channel with content that isn't currently optimised for discovery or lead generation. We are not looking to create new content at this stage — the priority is making what already exists work harder and to be able to continue to do so as new content is created.



What We Need

A two-month project in three phases:

 

Phase 1 — Audit (Week 1)

— Review the channel and deliver a written audit before making any changes

— Identify which videos have most potential and what's missing

— Give us recommendations, with three priority recommendations

— Analyse traffic source data to understand how people are currently finding the channel — YouTube search, suggested videos, external sources, browse features

— Research what headteachers are actually searching for on YouTube that connects to the problems Heads Up solves, so titles and descriptions in Phase 2 are built on real search behaviour



Phase 2 — Optimisation (Weeks 3–5)

— Rewrite and optimise titles to match real headteacher search behaviour and Heads Up brand voice

— Rewrite and optimise descriptions — first 2–3 lines matter most; include relevant language naturally and in line with current best practice

— Update tags across all videos

— Add captions to every video so they are always present

— Add chapters (named timestamps) to video descriptions to aid navigation and improve search visibility

— Add or update cards and end screens on every video

— Add a like prompt to every video to support the algorithm

— Optimise the channel page and playlist structure around the three Heads Up pathways

— Ensure all links use UTM tracking so email sign-ups from YouTube can be measured in Google Analytics



CTAs — where and what

Every video should have a consistent CTA stack. The primary destination across all placements is the relevant lead magnet or email sign-up. The secondary CTA is always watch next / subscribe.

— End screen (every video) — subscribe button, watch next video, and lead magnet link in the final 5–20 seconds

— Description (every video) — CTA in the first 2–3 lines (visible before “show more”) and again at the end of the full description

— Pinned comment (every video) — pointing to the key resource or next step

— Verbal mention (almost every video) — spoken prompt directing viewers to the link in the description; only omit if the video is very short or the prompt would feel forced

— Card (selective) — pop-up link at a natural moment mid-video; use where content naturally references something, do not force it



Success criteria

1. Every video has an optimised title, description, tags, captions, and a clear CTA

2. Cards and end screens direct viewers to the correct destination, including a ‘watch this next’ recommendation

3. The channel page and playlists are clean and structured around the three Heads Up pathways

4. All links use UTM tracking so email sign-ups from YouTube can be measured in Google Analytics



Phase 3 — One-page handover guide and insights

This phase delivers two things:

1. A reference guide so Heads Up can stay optimised going forward

— What was changed on each video and why

— A simple one-page reference Heads Up can use to maintain best practice going forward

2. Insights that will make future video content itself stronger — better structured, better performing, and easier to optimise from the start

— Audience retention data — at what point do viewers drop off, and what does that tell us about content length and structure in the video itself

— Which videos are performing best and why — topics, titles, format

— Best practice recommendations for future videos, covering both how to optimise a video once it’s live and how to structure content before filming so it performs better from day one

This list is not exhaustive, it is illustrative



How we work and how you’ll be paid

This is a part-time role for up to 2 months. Payment is milestone-based and tied to deliverable approval at each phase — we want someone invested in the quality of the outcome. You will be paid proportionally on satisfactory completion of each phase: the audit, the optimisation, and the handover guide and insights. If we are not satisfied with the quality of a deliverable, we will discuss it with you before proceeding to the next phase.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their work and committed to the outcome. For the right person, there is the possibility of an ongoing part-time role within the business beyond this initial project.





What We'll Provide

— Editor (Limited) access to the YouTube channel

— Our client messaging document

— Our Brand Book so you can retain our brand voice

— Clarity on CTA destinations before Phase 2 begins



What We Won't Provide

— Access to our website backend, Google account, or any other internal systems



Deliverables

Week 1: Written audit — no changes made yet

Week 2: Review and discussion — review audit findings, agree priorities, and confirm CTA destinations before optimisation begins

Weeks 3–5: Full channel optimisation

Week 5: One-page handover guide



Application question

Please send your applications through this online jobs portal by Monday 24th August 2026 9am (GMT).



Heads Up is a UK consultancy helping school leaders move from good to great. We have an existing YouTube channel that isn't yet optimised for discovery.



You have two options — choose one:



Option A: Analyse the Heads Up YouTube channel directly 



Option B: Find a YouTube channel in a professional services or coaching space (any industry) that you think is doing a good job of YouTube SEO



Whichever you choose, answer the following. Maximum 200 words per answer.



1.What is one specific thing being done with titles that helps the channel get found — and what makes it work?

2.What is one thing being done with cards, end screens, or CTAs that keeps viewers engaged or converts them — and why does it work?

3.What is the single biggest discoverability opportunity you can see — and how would you act on it?



Please be specific. Generic answers that could apply to any channel will not be considered. Include the channel name and URL.



Put application number #0005 in the subject line.

description:
I am building a portfolio of local lead-generation websites in the United States and am looking for an experienced SEO link-building specialist to help improve organic Google rankings.

This position will initially focus heavily on competitor backlink research and manual link prospecting. I am NOT looking for automated backlink packages, PBN blasts, thousands of profile links, blog-comment spam, or someone promising hundreds of backlinks per month.

Responsibilities:

- Research top-ranking local competitors using Ahrefs

- Analyze competitor referring domains and backlinks

- Use Ahrefs Link Intersect to identify backlink opportunities

- Find legitimate backlinks that competitors have acquired

- Research local and industry-specific directories/citations

- Find relevant home-service and contractor websites for outreach

- Identify guest-post, editorial, resource-page and niche-relevant link opportunities

- Conduct manual outreach to website owners when appropriate

- Track all prospects, outreach and acquired backlinks in Google Sheets

- Record DR, estimated organic traffic, target URL, anchor text, link type, status and cost

- Help develop a repeatable backlink-building process that can eventually be used across multiple local websites



Important:

Quality is much more important than quantity. Every backlink opportunity must be reviewed before purchasing or placing a paid backlink. Do not build or purchase links without approval.

I want links from real websites that are relevant, local, industry-related or have legitimate organic traffic. I do not want backlinks from obvious spam networks, automated backlink sites, gambling/adult sites, irrelevant foreign websites or sites created solely for selling links.



Experience preferred:

- Ahrefs

- Local SEO

- Competitor backlink analysis

- Link outreach

- Citation building

- Guest-post prospecting

- Google Sheets



Experience working with U.S. local service businesses such as HVAC, roofing, insulation, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, restoration, pest control, etc. is a major plus.



To apply:

Please begin your application with the word KNOXVILLE so I know you read the entire job post.

Then answer these questions:

1. How many years have you worked in SEO/link building?

2. Do you have experience using Ahrefs?

3. Explain how you determine whether a backlink is worth acquiring.

4. Explain the difference between a citation, guest post and niche edit.

5. Tell me about your experience with local SEO or local service businesses.

6. Provide examples of websites or campaigns where you helped build backlinks, if available.

7. What would you do during your first week if given a brand-new local service website with very few backlinks?

8. What hourly rate are you requesting?

Do NOT send me a generic list of backlink packages. I am looking for someone who can research, think and help build a long-term SEO process.

title: SEO Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them. THIS IS A FULL TIME ROLE.



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

 • Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

 • Crawlability and indexation

 • Site architecture and internal linking

 • Canonicalization and rendering issues

 • Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

 • Work directly within:

 • WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

 • Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

 • PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

 • Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

 • Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

 • Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

 • Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone



Required Skills & Experience

 • 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

 • Comfortable editing live websites and templates

 • Working knowledge of:

 • HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

 • PHP and Shopify Liquid

 • Experience working directly inside:

 • WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

 • Strong understanding of:

 • Google Search Console

 • Ahrefs / Semrush

 • Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

 • Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

 • Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

 • Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

 • Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

 • Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements



Important Notes

 • This is not a strategy-only or reporting-only role

 • Candidates who rely mainly on plugins, widgets, or third-party apps without understanding the underlying technical mechanics will not be suitable

 • You must be comfortable implementing changes yourself

This role puts you inside a client's creative team, close to the work and the decisions behind it.

**Work close to creative leadership.** Get direct feedback on your work from the brand's creative lead and see how a concept becomes a finished product.



**Grow through ownership.** Take on the asset library and your own projects as your work proves out.



**Build skills that compound.** Develop production, packaging, motion and AI-assisted design by shipping real work.



**[3] What you'll own**



- Produce print-ready files for packaging, product, flyers and postcards: correct dimensions, bleed, CMYK, outlined fonts, and clear notes for vendors.

- Design graphics and short-form motion and video for campaigns and social, using Canva, CapCut and the Adobe suite.

- Check and polish existing 3D product files in Blender (not modelling from scratch) and render them.

- Build mood boards and organize templates into a kit anyone on the team can use.

- Use AI tools, guided by good art direction taste, to speed up concepts and content.

- Keep editable files, folders and handoff notes organized so others can pick up your work.



This is a production role, not a creative direction role. Creative decisions stay with the creative lead. You'll take briefs from the team and block your own time for focused work.



By day 20, you'll be into the branding system, working on an existing project and producing monthly mood boards.



By day 30, you'll be looped into merch and small design projects, with Canva templates organized into a social branding kit.



By day 90, the goal is to run your own agenda, own a library of polished content, and support e-commerce banners.



**[4] What we're looking for**



- Real-world print and production file experience (product, packaging, print).

- Graphic design and basic motion skills, with a working level in Illustrator, Photoshop and Lightroom.

- Expert-level Canva and CapCut-level video editing.

- Working knowledge of Blender for checking, fixing and rendering existing 3D files.

- An editorial eye (magazine spreads, attitude over product-first) and a love of photography.

- Strong AI fluency with good art direction taste, ideally trained as a designer first.

- E-commerce content experience. Freelance experience is a plus, since it shows you can carry volume.

- A portfolio showing a body of work you're proud of. Client, personal or school projects all count.

- Self-motivated, passionate about the craft, and experimenting on your own. Early-career talent is welcome.

- Clear English, comfort with async communication, and the ability to take feedback and turn around revisions.

- Merch, apparel or product background, studio filming experience, or Mandarin for working with vendors are all a plus.



**[5] The setup**

- Full-time, long-term, remote, working Hong Kong hours (9am-6pm).

- Normally weekdays; occasional weekend flexibility may be needed.

- Exact hours and arrangements will be confirmed during hiring.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
CORPORATE SOCIAL MEDIA GRAPHIC DESIGNER JOB DESCRIPTION



PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a freelance graphic designer to develop high-impact creative assets for our internal social

media content. We will provide the completed social media copy and our brand guidelines. From there, we need

you to develop the visual concept. We are looking for a designer who can read a post, understand what it is

actually saying, identify the strongest visual opportunity within the message, and translate that into creative

that makes someone stop scrolling and want to know what we're talking about.



This is not an execution-only design role where detailed creative direction will be provided for every asset. The

copy is your creative brief. We need someone who can take it from there. And we are absolutely not looking for

a boring marketing snooze fest.



SCOPE OF WORK

For each assigned social media post, we will provide:

• Completed or approved social media copy

• Any required copy that must appear on the creative

• Our brand guidelines

• Brand assets as needed The freelance designer will be responsible for:

• Reading and understanding the provided social media copy

• Identifying the central idea, tension, hook, or message within the post

• Developing the visual concept independently

• Translating that concept into a compelling creative asset

• Creating or sourcing the imagery necessary to execute the concept

• Incorporating minor copy overlays when required

• Applying the brand appropriately without allowing branding to overpower the concept

• Preparing final assets in required social media dimensions and formats

• Completing reasonable revisions based on feedback



We are NOT looking to provide detailed creative direction for each post. Part of what we are hiring you for is

your ability to determine what the creative should be.



THE CREATIVE STANDARD

Our benchmark is simple: Someone should see the creative in their feed and think: "Whoa. What are they talking

about?" Then they should want to read the post. The creative needs to create curiosity before the copy provides

the answer.



PHOTO-FORWARD

Our preferred visual direction leans heavily toward photorealistic imagery rather than traditional graphic design-

heavy social posts. Images should feel sophisticated, dimensional, believable, polished, and intentionally

art-directed. They can also be unexpected and visually provocative. Or built around a metaphor someone

wouldn't immediately expect. As long as there is a strategic reason for it.



CONCEPT BEFORE DECORATION

We do not need someone to make our posts "look nice." We need someone to turn ideas into visual concepts.

If the post is about marketing performance, that does not automatically mean we want a dashboard. If it is

about growth, we don't automatically want an arrow pointing upward. If it is about AI, we don't automatically

want a robot. If it is about strategy, we don't automatically want a chessboard. Those are the obvious answers.

We are hiring someone to find the less obvious one.



WHAT WE DO NOT WANT

Please do not approach this project with:

• Generic corporate stock photography

• Template-driven social graphics

• Predictable marketing imagery

• Excessive copy on creative

• Generic icons surrounding headlines

• Random laptops, charts, dashboards, or graphs because the topic involves marketing

• Overused visual metaphors

• Creative that looks obviously AI-generated

• The same composition repeated with different headlines

• Designs that are technically polished but conceptually forgettable



There is one question we will consistently ask when reviewing creative: Could another marketing agency remove

our logo, add theirs, and post this tomorrow without anyone noticing? If the answer is yes, the concept probably

isn't strong enough.



AI-ASSISTED CREATIVE

We are comfortable with AI-assisted creative workflows and actively use AI within our own creative and

marketing processes. Photoshop, Illustrator, Firefly, generative AI, photography, compositing, stock assets, 3D,

or combinations of those tools are all acceptable. But AI is a production tool. It is not the creative director. We

still expect the designer to bring the concept, judgment, taste, composition, refinement, and final execution.

The finished asset should feel intentionally created rather than generated from the first prompt that produced

something usable.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Technical design ability matters. Conceptual ability matters more. We are looking for someone with:

• Strong conceptual thinking

• Excellent visual judgment

• The ability to interpret written messaging visually

• Experience creating social media creative

• Strong photo manipulation and/or compositing abilities

• An understanding of typography and visual hierarchy

• The ability to create polished photorealistic imagery

• Comfort using AI-assisted creative tools where appropriate

• The confidence to make creative decisions independently

• The ability to receive direct feedback and iterate quickly

• An understanding of what earns attention in a crowded social feed



We want someone who can read a social post and immediately start asking: "What's the visual idea hiding inside

this?" And then: "How do I make someone need to know what this is about?"



INITIAL ENGAGEMENT

This will begin as a freelance project engagement. The initial project will allow us to evaluate:

• Interpretation of the copy

• Strength of the visual concept

• Originality

• Creative judgment

• Quality of execution

• Ability to work independently

• Responsiveness to feedback

• Turnaround time

• Consistency across assets



We are not looking for someone to simply complete a handful of graphics and disappear. We would prefer to

find a designer who understands how we think, learns our visual language, and becomes a reliable extension of

our creative team. Strong performance on this initial engagement may lead to consistent, long-term freelance

creative work with us.



***WHEN RESPONDING*** Please include:

• A portfolio or examples of relevant work

• Examples demonstrating conceptual thinking

• Examples of photorealistic, composited, surreal, or highly art-directed creative

• Social media creative examples, if available

• Your typical turnaround time

• Your preferred project or per-asset pricing structure

• The primary creative and design tools you use



We are less interested in seeing 50 beautifully formatted graphics than we are in seeing five ideas we wish we'd

thought of ourselves. If your portfolio contains something that made a client say: "I never would have thought

of that." That's what we want to see.



SKILLS REQUIRED

Graphic Design

Concept Design

Concept Art

Visual Arts

Social Media Marketing

Content Creation

Visual Design

Photoshop

Illustrator

Adobe Photoshop

Canva

Highly organized



Fast-moving

Data-driven about recruiting

rather than:

Qualified candidates reaching interviews



Interview-to-offer rate
